rival_cooperate_entry.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_entry.text: The joint table stood beside the cold assay courtyard, well away from the working kiln. Qiu Lian had laid out two shallow brass pans, a wooden beam and a row of clay buttons. Her black braid rested against the cinnabar back of her robe. She looked up when Yue arrived. 'I thought you would choose another table,' she said. 'I thought you would object to sharing one,' Yue answered. Neither smiled immediately. Between them, the unassembled fixture looked harmless enough to accommodate an argument.

rival_cooperate_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_002.text: Su Yao drew a stool into the shade with her heel. Its low back would let Yue rest her affected shoulder without a raised reach. 'The joint fixture remains an elective trial,' she said. 'Three afternoons already checked against your free intervals. Today we make it intelligible. Tomorrow we expose it to ordinary handling. The last afternoon we decide what, if anything, the evidence permits.' Qiu nodded at the stool before looking away. Yue noticed the small courtesy and did not turn it into a debt.

rival_cooperate_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_003.text: Qiu's proposal used a light beam held between two guides. A tiny pan hung at either end, and a springless wooden latch caught the beam when the pans were level. A person could open the latch, add the agreed clay load and close it again without moving a hand higher than the breastbone. Nothing would be heated, energized or connected to a working machine. Yue held the beam at its center while Qiu steadied the empty pans. The little apparatus swayed between them like a question awaiting proper punctuation.

rival_cooperate_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_004.text: 'A catch that closes quickly isn't a catch that closes correctly,' Yue said. Qiu pointed to a pale line on the beam. 'Then give correctly a place to stand. If you only wait until you feel satisfied, another operator cannot repeat you.' Yue had expected a demand for speed; she had not expected that accusation to be precise. She set the beam down before answering. 'We need to agree what counts as closed.' Qiu's expression sharpened. 'Yes. That is exactly the work I came to do.'

rival_cooperate_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_005.text: Their first sketch showed an ordinary latch in the side view and an implausibly perfect alignment in the top view. Yue turned the paper so the two drawings could be compared. The latch's nose would push the beam sideways unless its approach had room to drift.

rival_cooperate_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_006.text: Yue wanted a stop pin beside the latch. It would let the operator see whether the beam returned to the same position after release. Qiu wanted a thin witness strip beneath the latch nose, marked when contact occurred. A pin might turn a wandering return into a stable looking forced stop; a strip might change the very contact it witnessed. They drew both flaws before choosing parts. The disagreement became less personal once each woman had to give the other's objection a shape that a carpenter could understand.

rival_cooperate_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_007.text: The beam was cut from an old straight offcut. Qiu turned it end for end and said its knot would make the right side stiff. Yue laid a fingertip on the shallow grain around the knot. 'We can use it for the demonstration of assembly. We should not compare catches on it.' Qiu looked toward the waiting audience benches. 'The other offcut is shorter.' 'Then our pan separation is shorter.' The apparent inconvenience cost them less than pretending the piece of wood had no history.

rival_cooperate_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_008.text: Su fetched the shorter offcut from a cupboard whose doors opened at waist height. The facility grant remained with her; a borrowed ruler and the returned beam went on her supply page. Yue's purse stayed tied at her belt. Qiu did not ask to be paid for the redesign. She tested the new piece on the flat table, pressing gently at each end. 'I prefer a reason for losing ten minutes,' she said. 'You have one,' Yue replied. 'I have an opportunity to see whether it matters,' Qiu corrected.

rival_cooperate_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_009.text: A small audience had begun to collect: a repairer eating a pear, a woman waiting for a glazed bowl and two young porters whose task had finished early. They could watch from the chalk line, ask questions during pauses or leave whenever they wished. Su asked nobody to lend a body to the apparatus. One porter asked whether Four pairs made the beam easier to balance. 'Our realm has no place in this measurement,' Qiu said. 'You can see the pans without borrowing our cultivation.'

rival_cooperate_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_010.text: Yue appreciated the answer, although Qiu's hand moved as if dismissing a foolish child. The porter leaned back, stung. Yue picked up the two clay buttons and held them where everyone could see. 'A question about a hidden influence is reasonable. These are ordinary cold parts. We are looking at the catch and our handling.' Qiu gave the porter a more careful glance. 'Yes. You were asking what you couldn't inspect.' He resumed eating his pear. The correction took two sentences and saved the afternoon from needless hostility.

rival_cooperate_011.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_011.text: Their clay buttons had been dried elsewhere and were borrowed already cold. They called them small loads rather than weights of any universal standard. Each button bore a different notch, and the two used together could be exchanged between pans. Qiu said a comparison needed the same named objects, not a claim that all clay buttons weighed alike. Yue set aside a chipped example. Its loose corner could shed material between runs. The repairer on the bench began to attend more closely when they refused the prettiest matching pair.

rival_cooperate_012.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_012.text: Qiu slipped an empty pan off its hook and placed it inside the other. The nested rims touched at three points. 'These are not twins either,' she said. Yue examined the narrow lip of the lower pan. 'We can label left and right, then exchange the whole pan assembly in the later check.' 'You will spend the entire afternoon discovering the existence of objects.' 'Only the objects we are about to use.' Qiu laughed then, briefly and without kindness. Yue answered the laugh by writing the two labels.

rival_cooperate_013.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_013.text: Su did not settle their dispute for them. She asked a different question: 'What can an observer recognize without trusting either author?' Qiu held up the witness strip. Yue held up the stop pin. Neither answer satisfied the steward. An observer had to know the latch's position, the beam's freedom and the named load. Yue drew three boxes on the slate. Qiu added a fourth: the release itself. If a hand stayed on the beam, a neat closure could hide the hand's work.

rival_cooperate_014.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_014.text: They placed the table so the audience could see the gap under each guide. The change put Yue's chair on the left rather than the right. Qiu began to rotate the whole fixture to preserve her favored side, then caught herself. 'Can you reach the low tray there?' Yue tried the reach with an empty hand. Her shoulder objected to the outward angle. They moved the tray inward. Qiu's preferred approach survived only after the working space accommodated the person who would share it.

rival_cooperate_015.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_015.text: Nobody named the rearrangement an act of generosity. Yue had work to do with the arm she actually possessed. Qiu had a design to defend under conditions she could actually show. They marked a hand resting place on either side of the fixture, low and near the body. The fixture's smallness let the change remain simple. Yue could slide a button along the table into Qiu's reach rather than lifting it across. Su checked that no cord hung where the chair legs might catch it.

rival_cooperate_016.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_016.text: A visitor in a patched hat suggested tying both wrists to the rest marks to prove there was no assistance. Qiu refused before Yue could speak. 'We are testing a tool for people, not proving a person's obedience. If hands leave the marks, we say the run differs.'

rival_cooperate_017.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_017.text: The latch had a broad wooden tongue sliding sideways into a shallow notch. Qiu wanted its motion short enough to repeat without a flourish. Yue found a burr on the tongue where it had been cut. Qiu rubbed it against the smooth stone provided for cold finishing.

rival_cooperate_018.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_018.text: Yue suggested removing the notch shoulder before establishing a reference. Qiu stopped her hand over the stone. 'If we smooth everything until it works, what are we learning about closure?' 'We are learning about this fixture. We can record the fault before we remove it.'

rival_cooperate_019.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_019.text: Their corrected tongue closed the empty fixture six times without catching. Su wrote the count on the slate, then drew a line beneath it. Those empty rehearsals established handling, not successful loaded trials. Qiu was impatient with the line until a porter asked whether six closures meant her design had won.

rival_cooperate_020.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_020.text: A bell rang from the quay. The pear eater left to collect a repaired handle. A bowl customer stayed because her glaze was not ready, then admitted she also wanted to see which woman would concede first. Yue resisted asking her to choose a favorite.

rival_cooperate_021.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_021.text: Qiu's quick witness strip was a thin rectangle of dry paper rubbed with charcoal at one end. When the tongue crossed the mark, the strip should show a narrow rub. Yue's stop pin was removable, with a white scratch line indicating its seated depth. It would stand beside the beam, not carry the beam's load. They agreed that a pin jammed against the beam would invalidate the run. The two witnesses were different kinds of evidence. Neither could alone prove that the loaded beam had settled freely.

rival_cooperate_022.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_022.text: The pan hooks were too sharp to share casually. Qiu folded a rag around the empty pan while Su covered the spare hook. Yue could steady the beam from the low rest as Qiu attached the pans. Once attached, the pans hung within a finger's breadth of the tabletop.

rival_cooperate_023.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_023.text: They wrote a stopping rule before a loaded closure: any scrape of pan against table, unexpected strain, displaced guide, lost button or pain would stop the run. Qiu disliked adding pain to a list of instrument defects. 'Pain is an operator condition,' she said. 'And the comparison uses operators,' Yue answered. Su asked Qiu whether a successful run while an operator hid pain would teach them a usable method. Qiu folded the slate edge cloth carefully. 'Write it as an operator stop. We should know which thing failed.'

rival_cooperate_024.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_024.text: The distinction mattered to Yue. A shoulder stop would not automatically mean Qiu's latch failed. A latch stop would not imply Yue had lacked courage. They gave separate places to those observations. The audience could hear the terms without receiving anyone's medical history. Yue's old restriction required no new account of its origin. She tested the low movement once, rested and reported that it stayed comfortable. Qiu asked for the same rest opportunity for herself. 'Otherwise I will make fast look like endless,' she said.

rival_cooperate_025.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_025.text: Su measured the remaining afternoon against the shadow at the courtyard post. There was time for one preliminary series, a pause and a repeat with changed handling. There was no time for every scheme they had drawn. Qiu favored assigning each woman her own witness so responsibility would stay clear.

rival_cooperate_026.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_026.text: Before Yue chose, Qiu put down her brush. 'If you stop the comparison, say it is because the question is not ready. Don't call me reckless in a soft voice.' Yue felt the justice of the request and the edge of its delivery. 'And if I choose to work slowly, don't call the remaining time a moral failure.' Su looked from one to the other. 'You both want your reason heard before the other supplies a story about you. Put that in the conversation, not the result column.'

rival_cooperate_027.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_027.text: They walked once around the empty fixture. From the audience side, Yue's stop line was easier to see than the charcoal strip. From Qiu's side, the strip could be inspected without moving the head. From the far corner, one pan hid the beam's end. A porter's simple question about where to stand had disclosed a weakness neither inventor had noticed. Qiu shifted the viewing line outward. Yue left space beside it for a closer inspection during pauses. Publicly checkable needed a place for an ordinary pair of eyes.

rival_cooperate_028.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_028.text: The bowl customer pointed out that everybody would forget which button went where. Qiu reached for a speech about attention, then chose a simpler response. Each button's notch was drawn large on a card, and the cards went in matching spaces under the two pan labels. Yue wrote the exchange order beside them. An observer need not recognize a tiny mark at a distance if the object was shown before use. Qiu thanked the woman with an abruptness that made the woman straighten, pleased and slightly startled.

rival_cooperate_029.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_029.text: Yue did not want a vote on scientific truth. She wanted the people at the chalk line to know what they could challenge. Qiu explained that anyone could report a hand remaining on the beam or a pan touching the mat.

rival_cooperate_030.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_030.text: That sentence changed the air between them. Yue had heard Qiu described as someone who prized throughput, and Qiu plainly did. But the fast closures she wanted were not merely a display of superior fingers. She wanted a method that could leave its author's hands and still work.

rival_cooperate_031.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_031.text: The first tiny load sat ready in its marked saucer. Su touched neither the beam nor the choice. The table smelled of fresh wood dust and the sour warmth of the cloth drying near the doorway. Beyond the wall, bowls clinked against each other and someone argued about a cartwheel. Their trial was small enough to stop, small enough to repeat and public enough to embarrass both authors. Yue placed her good hand beside the slate. Qiu waited with a patience that looked like effort rather than ease.

rival_cooperate_tasks.speaker: lin_yue
rival_cooperate_tasks.text: They had a shared question but different ways to approach it. Dividing duties would preserve each inventor's familiar method and reveal how the two witnesses compared in one setup. Exchanging methods would test whether the instructions survived a change of hands. Stopping the affected comparison would give them time to isolate the fixture's remaining ambiguities without making a winner today. Yue chose what they would actually do with this afternoon; the other plans would remain unperformed proposals.

choices.text: Divide the duties and compare each familiar witness within the shared fixture.
Exchange the witnessed methods and test whether the instructions survive new hands.
Stop today's affected comparison and isolate the fixture's uncertainties together.

rival_cooperate_divide_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_001.text: Yue proposed a narrow division: Qiu would operate the latch and inspect the charcoal strip; Yue would place and remove the stop pin and report whether its scratch line returned. Neither would pronounce the whole run successful alone. Qiu accepted after adding that both observations would be spoken before either woman looked at the other's mark. The separation prevented one confident report from pulling the second into agreement. Su gave them opposite corners of the same page, close enough to compare after the words had been said.

rival_cooperate_divide_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_002.text: The first button slid from its saucer into Yue's good hand. She brought it to the near pan without leaning outward. Qiu kept two fingers on the low rest. The beam tipped almost invisibly. Yue seated the pin to its white line, checked the gap and withdrew her hand. Qiu opened the tongue. The near pan sank, then rose when Yue added the second named button to the far pan. Neither pan touched the mat. For several breaths the beam continued a small lazy motion.

rival_cooperate_divide_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_003.text: 'Ready,' Qiu said too soon for Yue's liking. She drew the tongue across. Its nose caught the beam as the right end still descended. Yue's pin line appeared true, but the beam pressed against the pin. 'Contact at the pin,' Yue reported. Qiu looked at the charcoal strip. A broad rubbed patch covered its mark. 'Contact during travel,' she replied. The audience had seen a closure. Their paired reports showed why it was not the closure they had agreed to count.

rival_cooperate_divide_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_004.text: Qiu wanted to repeat immediately. Yue removed both buttons first and asked her to explain the premature ready. 'The motion was becoming small,' Qiu said. 'I used the next downward pass.' Yue thought about the beam touching its pin. 'Then our return sign isn't a settled sign. It can visit the correct place while moving.' Qiu bent over the drawing. Her speed had uncovered a defect in Yue's language rather than only a flaw in her own timing. Yue crossed out the word returned and wrote remained.

rival_cooperate_divide_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_005.text: Su asked how long remained meant. Neither woman had brought a useful clock into the fixture's low space. Counting spoken breaths would vary between voices; waiting for absolute stillness would make the endpoint imaginary. Qiu proposed two separate observations of the same gap, divided by an empty opening and closing of her fingers at the hand rest. Yue objected that Qiu could shorten the gesture. They settled on Su's two audible taps against the table, at a comfortable pace she demonstrated before the series.

rival_cooperate_divide_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_006.text: The taps were a local aid, not a promise of a universal interval. Qiu said that limitation aloud. On the second run Yue watched the gap through both taps. She could see a sliver of light beside the pin each time.

rival_cooperate_divide_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_007.text: The third run produced the same reports but a different latch feel. Qiu described the tongue as heavier. The result would have looked clean if she had kept that difference to herself. Yue checked the guide without pulling it apart. A faint strand of cloth had lodged near its entrance, probably from the wrapped pan. She could not prove when it had arrived. They marked the run as uncertain, removed the strand with a small wooden pick and emptied the pans before beginning another series.

rival_cooperate_divide_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_008.text: Qiu regarded the discarded run with visible annoyance. 'We are losing one of three.' 'We are keeping a cause we didn't know to inspect,' Yue said. 'That sounds like an elegant way to lose one of three.' Yue laid the strand on the saucer beside the removed wood shaving. 'Yes. It is still lost as a comparable run.' Qiu studied her face for a moment, then laughed. The laugh this time included Yue. Saying the plain loss had made room for the useful consequence.

rival_cooperate_divide_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_009.text: A woman at the chalk line asked whether each new obstruction would let them restart forever. Su pointed to the afternoon shadow. Their trial had an end even if their doubts did not. They would retain the attempted run with its uncertainty and perform only the remaining planned opportunities. Qiu counted the clean strips left in her packet. Yue counted the low movements her shoulder could tolerate before its rest. Both counts limited the series without claiming that a limit could improve the evidence.

rival_cooperate_divide_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_010.text: They made two more closures. One satisfied both witnesses. The last showed a free pin gap but a double charcoal rub because Qiu's tongue had bounced slightly when her fingertip left it. The latch stayed closed, yet the mark could not be called narrow and single. Qiu drew the bounce as two short arrows. Yue resisted consoling her by changing the criterion after seeing the mark. Qiu resisted blaming the strip before looking at her own motion. Their separate duties had kept authorship clear enough to make admission possible.

rival_cooperate_divide_011.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_011.text: During the pause, Qiu asked Yue to repeat the pin instruction exactly as she would give it to a stranger. Yue began with the gap, remembered the seated depth and started again. Qiu waited. The second account was better but still included 'normal pressure,' a phrase Yue could not demonstrate without a person feeling it. She replaced it with seat to the line, then release. Qiu's own latch account included gently, which failed the same test. They were discovering that familiar work collected invisible adjectives.

rival_cooperate_divide_012.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_012.text: The division had let each woman recognize her own witness well, but it had not shown that either witness could travel safely into another operator's hands. They wrote that limitation under the result. Qiu refused to call it a fatal flaw. 'Today it answered a smaller question.'

rival_cooperate_divide_013.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_013.text: At the audience line, the bowl customer gave her own summary: 'The pin can look right while the beam is still moving, and the strip can tell you a hand bounced.' Qiu nodded. Yue added that neither witness replaced checking the pans. The customer frowned at the apparatus. 'That is less tidy than I wanted.' 'It is tidier than pretending one mark tells us everything,' Qiu said. The woman considered that while wrapping her newly delivered bowl in its cloth. She left with the result she had actually understood.

rival_cooperate_divide_014.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_014.text: Qiu copied the improved words onto two small instruction cards. Yue watched her brush stop over the order of the names. 'Yue's pin; Lian's latch,' Qiu said. 'And our fixture?' Yue asked. They wrote both names beside the joint drawing and each name beside its contributed part. Sharing a page did not turn a separately proposed idea into anonymous property. Su gave them a second sheet so they could each retain the same public summary without removing the facility's working original.

rival_cooperate_divide_015.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_015.text: The divided series ended before Yue's shoulder became tired enough to change her reach. She said so and set the pin in its tray. Qiu marked the operator stop as preventive rather than painful. That precision pleased Yue more than praise would have.

rival_cooperate_divide_016.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_016.text: Su covered the assembled fixture with a loose cloth after confirming that nothing pressed the beam. The sheet for this route named divided duties, familiar operators and incomplete transfer instructions. Those facts would matter when they returned to the comparison after rain. Qiu left her instruction card under a flat board so it would not curl. Yue placed her copy in her own satchel. Neither had performed the exchanged-method series or the stopped comparison. They went toward the kitchen with the result of this division between them.

rival_cooperate_swap_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_001.text: Yue chose to exchange the two methods before comparing their marks. Qiu gave her the latch card and received the pin card in return. They would each perform the other's low movement after an empty rehearsal, and either could stop if the fit was poor. Qiu read Yue's words aloud without improving them. The phrase 'settle against the proper line' made her frown. 'Against, or beside?' she asked. Yue looked at the pin she had drawn. A word she thought obvious had already failed its journey.

rival_cooperate_swap_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_002.text: They amended the pin instruction to preserve a visible gap beside the seated pin. Qiu could reach its tray without a long shoulder movement, but Yue's latch tray lay too far outward. She moved it inward with Qiu's agreement before trying the slide. Her good hand could operate the tongue while the affected arm rested. Qiu watched the reach and crossed the original tray position out of her sketch. Transferring a method required transferring an arrangement that another body could use, not merely handing over its clever part.

rival_cooperate_swap_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_003.text: The first empty rehearsal stuck halfway. Qiu leaned forward, then held herself still while Yue described what she felt. 'It turns under my fingertip.' Qiu's familiar motion had pressed slightly down as well as sideways, a detail missing from her card. A broad wooden thumb rest could prevent the tongue from rolling without asking Yue to imitate that pressure. Su found a small flat offcut. Qiu held it beside the tongue and showed where it could be fixed reversibly with a loop below the table edge.

rival_cooperate_swap_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_004.text: Yue rejected the first loop because its knot sat beside the pan clearance. Qiu moved the knot to the outside and tried again. They used no glue and cut no new notch. If the thumb rest changed the return, they could remove it and see the original arrangement. The reversibility mattered because the alteration had begun as an answer to unfamiliar handling. Qiu did not want to forget what her original latch needed. Yue did not want a comfortable modification to pass unnoticed as the same design.

rival_cooperate_swap_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_005.text: With the thumb rest held securely, Yue completed two empty slides and one loaded rehearsal. Qiu inserted the stop pin too far and saw the beam touch it. She had read the scratch line as a minimum depth rather than the final seat. Yue explained the error without taking the pin back. They enlarged the line and placed a collar beneath it so the position could be seen and felt with low force. Qiu remarked that an inventor's confident card had been less helpful than an ordinary little collar.

rival_cooperate_swap_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_006.text: Su separated the rehearsals from the planned transfer series. Both women had changed instructions and added reversible guides. The transferred method was now a revised method. Qiu wanted to preserve the original cards beside the new cards; Yue wanted a diagram of the added parts. They did both. A porter asked which version spectators should judge. 'The one we say we are using,' Yue replied. Qiu showed the old card anyway. 'And you may ask why it changed. That is a useful kind of judging.'

rival_cooperate_swap_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_007.text: The first recorded exchanged run began with Qiu placing the named button in the near pan. Yue kept her latch fingers on the low rest until Qiu released the beam. The empty far pan rose, then returned after its button was added.

rival_cooperate_swap_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_008.text: They did not celebrate the successful transfer before checking the second run. Yue found the strip awkward to lift for inspection because its free end lay under the tongue. Qiu had always plucked it with a nail; the action invited a sharp sideways motion near the pan. They extended the strip's free end toward Yue's resting hand. The extra length might alter its drag. Qiu proposed showing that uncertainty instead of pretending the improvement came without a cost. Yue added a second empty rehearsal with the longer strip.

rival_cooperate_swap_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_009.text: The longer strip curled slightly and gave a broad mark even when the tongue moved cleanly. Yue laid the original short strip beside it. Qiu held both under the same flat board for a pause, then compared their edges. Neither would claim the curl had vanished just because the surfaces looked flatter.

rival_cooperate_swap_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_010.text: A repairer on the bench wanted to know whether the apparatus now belonged to Yue because her hands had forced two revisions. Qiu answered immediately. 'My latch remains my proposal. The transfer guides are our revisions. Her pin remains hers, and its collar is a joint revision.'

rival_cooperate_swap_011.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_011.text: The next two exchanged runs produced clean reports. The fourth bounced against a guide when Qiu moved a button from the wrong side. She stopped before Yue closed the latch. The near pan swung wide enough to brush the mat. That was an operator departure, not a demonstrated failure of the revised latch. Qiu named it herself. Yue entered the stopped attempt rather than quietly beginning again. Public transfer had made each woman vulnerable to the other's instructions and to her own ordinary mistake.

rival_cooperate_swap_012.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_012.text: Qiu asked to repeat that placement during an empty rehearsal. The question seemed innocent until Yue saw her shoulder rising with impatience. 'Your reach has changed,' Yue said. Qiu looked at her own elbow and lowered it. She was not injured in the same way, but she could still make a poor movement. The revised card moved the button saucer closer. Su kept the change in the record. A transfer series could expose the inventor as an unfamiliar operator too; that was part of what made it informative.

rival_cooperate_swap_013.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_013.text: At the end of the planned series, their clean runs described a revised fixture with transferred hands. They did not compare its count directly with Qiu's unmodified rehearsals. Qiu said this cost her the claim she had arrived wanting to make: that her first latch already needed only a few clear words. Yue did not press the loss. 'It gave you words you can now show.' 'And parts I did not intend to need.' 'Yes.' The agreement was uncomfortable enough to remain honest.

rival_cooperate_swap_014.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_014.text: They each wrote a sentence about what the exchange had changed in their understanding. Yue wrote that a proper return could not depend on an unspoken depth. Qiu wrote that a short latch movement could still conceal pressure, fingertip angle and a private way of removing the strip. Neither sentence blamed the unfamiliar operator. Su let them read their own words to the audience. The bowl customer said the revisions sounded useful for her father, whose fingers shook. Qiu considered the remark without offering him an untested promise.

rival_cooperate_swap_015.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_015.text: The added collar, thumb rest and lift tab came off cleanly. Qiu inspected the original fixture and replaced the guides exactly as marked. Yue watched the beam remain clear. Their reversible changes had earned that description by being reversed, not by looking removable on paper. They preserved both states in the drawing. Tomorrow's handling would use the revised transfer arrangement unless the conditions required a declared change. Qiu put the removed loop in the tray so nobody could mistake a loose cord for a working part.

rival_cooperate_swap_016.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_016.text: Su covered the fixture and closed the afternoon sheet. This route had transferred both methods and revised their instructions; it had not performed a familiar-operator comparison or abandoned the question. Qiu carried those exact limits toward the kitchen with something like pride. Yue carried the original cards as a reminder that a clearer method could come from discomfort without making the first author foolish. Behind them, a porter rehearsed the words visible gap under his breath. He had discovered a phrase precise enough to take elsewhere.

rival_cooperate_stop_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_001.text: Yue chose to stop the affected comparison before its first counted run. Qiu's jaw tightened. She had imagined leaving today with a number beside her latch. Yue pointed to the conflicting words on their cards: returned, settled and closed. 'We cannot compare until these describe the same event.' Su marked the comparison unperformed and left the apparatus uncovered. Stopping that question did not end the afternoon. It gave them permission to ask a smaller one without dressing its answer as victory.

rival_cooperate_stop_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_002.text: Qiu insisted they name the next question sharply. Yue suggested testing whether the pin and strip could distinguish a moving passage from a free settled return. The latch would be operated empty or under the agreed tiny loads, but no series count would decide whose witness was better. Qiu accepted the question after crossing out the word settled. 'We will first discover what signs each gives during known conditions.' Yue felt the resistance in that first. It gave the work a direction without pretending the postponement had been painless.

rival_cooperate_stop_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_003.text: They began with a deliberately moving beam. Yue touched the low beam end with her good hand, made a small visible displacement and released it. Qiu waited with the tongue open. The pin gap appeared, disappeared and appeared again as the beam rocked. The audience could see why one glance was insufficient. Qiu drew three positions, making the middle beam slightly crooked. Her drawing was uglier than the first perfect sketch and more useful. Yue thanked her for showing the moving condition before proposing a cure for it.

rival_cooperate_stop_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_004.text: Next Qiu closed the tongue while the beam was visibly rocking. The charcoal strip took a long smeared mark. Yue watched the pin touch. Both witnesses distinguished that deliberately poor closure. Su wrote induced movement at the top of the page, because nobody should later mistake the demonstration for a normal failed attempt. A porter asked whether they could force every failure to be obvious. 'Some defects are smaller than our eyes,' Yue said. 'That is why we won't declare this question answered by the loudest example.'

rival_cooperate_stop_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_005.text: They tested a gentler motion. Yue displaced the end only far enough for the gap to blink once. Qiu closed the tongue after the second visible pass. The strip showed a narrow mark despite remaining motion. The pin gap looked clear when Su approached and closed when she stepped back. Their witnesses could both give reassuring signs during an unsuitable condition. Qiu stared at the charcoal strip. 'The mark remembers contact, not stillness.' Yue answered, 'The gap shows a position, not how we arrived there.'

rival_cooperate_stop_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_006.text: The distinction released Qiu from defending the strip as a complete truth. She could ask what it actually did well. It recorded whether the tongue rubbed once, bounced or dragged through a long travel. Yue's pin could show a changed return position or contact with the stop. They were complementary observations, provided the settling condition had its own rule. Su asked what simple local aid they could show publicly. After trying spoken counts and rejecting their variability, they used her two table taps with the beam free between them.

rival_cooperate_stop_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_007.text: A child outside the chalk line began tapping too. Su smiled and asked him to stop while the operators listened to the designated signal. The child's mother offered to take him away; Qiu shook her head. 'He found the vulnerable part of the method.' They moved Su's tapping place closer to the fixture and spoke the word first before each pair of taps. Their solution remained bounded to this little public session. Nobody would claim that every workshop needed a steward tapping a table to close a latch.

rival_cooperate_stop_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_008.text: They also tested the pin's seated depth without the beam in place. Qiu inserted it to three depths and asked the audience which looked correct. From the benches, the white scratch line could disappear behind the guide. Yue added a narrow collar under the line. The collar would not bear load; it would show the depth. They tested that by setting the pin aside and looking at the beam alone. Su recorded the added collar as a construction revision arising from an unperformed comparison.

rival_cooperate_stop_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_009.text: The witness strip needed its own visibility check. Qiu showed a clean strip, a narrow rubbed strip and a deliberately smeared strip to the audience during a pause. The bowl customer could tell the smear but confused the clean and narrow examples in the courtyard shadow. Qiu moved to the loggia's brighter edge, then brought a pale board back to place behind the inspected strip. A public sign that required the inventor's unusually close glance had failed part of Qiu's own ambition.

rival_cooperate_stop_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_010.text: Yue proposed placing a small scale beside the strip's rub. Qiu disliked pretending they could measure a soft charcoal edge accurately. They chose simple named categories with examples preserved: unmarked, narrow single rub, broad or multiple rub. An uncertain example would remain uncertain. Su wrote that the categories were local and visual. Qiu laid the examples under the same board used for inspection, so light and distance would be similar. The result was less grand than a precise number and easier for a visitor to challenge.

rival_cooperate_stop_011.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_011.text: They discovered a problem with the pan labels during the exchange of unloaded pans. The hooks differed slightly in angle, making the pan heights change after the swap. Qiu had expected the pans to be interchangeable. Yue suggested recording the assemblies rather than just the bowls. They drew each pan with its hook and cord. A bowl customer could see the asymmetry when Qiu held them side by side at a safe low height. The stopped comparison had exposed an object they would otherwise have named too loosely.

rival_cooperate_stop_012.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_012.text: Qiu sat on the edge of her stool and regarded the growing row of examples. 'At this rate we can publish a beautiful account of why we have no answer.' Yue asked which part she would remove to get an answer she could defend.

rival_cooperate_stop_013.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_013.text: They agreed on a modest result for the afternoon: two partial witnesses, a declared settling aid and drawings of the actual pan assemblies. No valid comparison count existed. The empty and deliberately disturbed demonstrations were evidence about those particular observations. Su read the summary slowly, and Qiu corrected one word. 'You wrote reliable categories. Write clearer categories. We haven't shown reliability across people.' Yue made the change herself. Qiu's precision had become especially fierce where a flattering word tried to creep into the substitute result.

rival_cooperate_stop_014.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_014.text: The audience did not uniformly appreciate the work. One porter left before the last demonstration, bored by the repeated release of an empty beam. The bowl customer stayed and asked for the charcoal examples to be shown again. Both responses were ordinary. Qiu did not call the departing man incapable of understanding. Yue did not reward the remaining woman with a special claim. Their public trial owed each visitor a clear account, not an afternoon so entertaining that nobody chose something else to do.

rival_cooperate_stop_015.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_015.text: They dismantled the pin collar and replaced it once to confirm its position. The lighting board rested beyond the moving parts. The preserved strips went in a dry paper sleeve with their named conditions on the back. Qiu wrote proposed future comparison on a new card and left the result space empty. She looked at Yue. 'Tomorrow I want us to answer something that can fail.' Yue nodded. 'It already failed to be ready today.' 'I mean the fixture.' Both women understood the difference and kept it.

rival_cooperate_stop_016.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_016.text: Su marked this route as a stopped comparison with diagnostic demonstrations. It had produced clearer setup terms and visible examples, not a successful latch series or a transferred method. Those distinctions would constrain the later rain recovery. Qiu tucked the empty comparison card beside the diagnostic page without trying to fill it. Yue covered the low table. Their walk to the kitchen began in an awkward silence, but the silence contained a joint apparatus they had each made harder to praise carelessly.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_001.text: The shared kitchen was between meals. A cook had left a pot of thin millet soup near the coals and a covered dish of pickled greens on a low shelf. He offered the waiting women leftover soup before the evening work began. The facility grant remained separate with Su. Qiu and Yue were guests at the small table, not recipients of a cash prize. Qiu drew a bench out with one foot. Yue sat where her shoulder could lean against the wall without the table trapping her elbow.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_002.text: For a time they discussed nothing sharper than soup. Qiu preferred the greens sliced finer; Yue liked the thick stems that kept their bite. Su took the last piece of radish and made no attempt to arbitrate. The cook came to retrieve a bowl and asked what the women had been measuring. Qiu began with repeatability, saw his eyes drift to the pot and changed her answer. 'Whether a little catch closes the same way after someone else checks it.' He nodded. 'Then don't put soup on the instructions.'

rival_cooperate_kitchen_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_003.text: Qiu dried the bottom of her bowl before setting it near her papers. Yue noticed she used the same careful circular wipe on every bowl. 'You make fast motions until you want a motion to leave no trace,' Yue said. Qiu looked down at the cloth. 'Water stains spread when nobody watches.' She seemed ready to turn that into an argument about checking. Instead she folded the cloth and said, 'My mother hated circles on her table. The wiping outlived the table.' Yue let the memory remain small.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_004.text: Yue spoke of a road meal eaten from a chipped cup whose crack she had learned to hold away from her lip. Qiu asked whether she had kept it. 'No. Learning its fault did not oblige me to carry it forever.' Qiu smiled at the sentence, then looked toward the folded instruction cards. 'You are prepared to be ruthless with cups.' 'Only after they cut me.' Their apparatus could wait while two women tried the ordinary pleasure of being amusing to one another.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_005.text: The cook's younger sister arrived with a basket of washed spring onions. She was curious about the public trial but had seen only the audience leaving. Qiu offered to explain the result; Yue asked whether she wanted the explanation now. The woman shook her head. 'I want to know whether you will use my clean table tomorrow when it rains.' Su said they had reserved the loggia for wet weather, not the kitchen. The woman visibly relaxed. A clear boundary earned more welcome than any account of elegant closure.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_006.text: They heard the weather before seeing it. A loose shutter rattled at the quay, and the kitchen's hanging ladle struck the wall once. Qiu rose to latch the shutter, then stopped with her bowl still in her hand.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_007.text: Su left briefly to check that the fixture's cover would not collect water through the courtyard roof gap. The two women remained with the onions and the last soup. Qiu asked, 'Do you expect speed always to be dishonest?' Yue put down her spoon. 'No.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_008.text: Qiu had learned instrument work in a shop that returned repairs to people who could not afford long absences from their tools. She spoke of a farmer waiting three days for a latch that might have taken one afternoon.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_009.text: Yue said she had seen an early departure consume the whole saving it claimed to create. A workman hurried off with an uncertain reading, returned for a second inspection and blamed the weather rather than his first omission. Qiu did not demand his name.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_010.text: Su returned and joined the table without treating the conversation as evidence for the fixture. The women could understand one another better without making that understanding a valid trial result. She brought a dry cloth that smelled faintly of stored cedar and placed it near the cards. The cover over the apparatus was sound. A drain beside the courtyard remained clear. Those observations described the moment she had inspected it. Tomorrow might require a fresh inspection. Qiu sighed at the qualification and accepted it without a quarrel.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_011.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_011.text: A bowl slipped from the cook's hands at the washing shelf. It struck a folded mat instead of the floor and remained whole. Everybody looked up, then laughed at the cook's exaggerated bow to the mat. Yue noticed Qiu's hand had moved toward the sound before she had seen what fell. Qiu caught her glance. 'There is your hidden instinct.' Yue answered, 'An instinct can begin a look. It cannot finish one.' The cook raised the saved bowl. 'My look says I still have washing to do.'

rival_cooperate_kitchen_012.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_012.text: They helped clear the table at a pace suited to Yue's low reach. Qiu carried the heavier stack, while Yue wiped each emptied place without twisting her shoulder. Neither action was part of a promised contest result. At the shelf, Yue found the pickled greens jar's lid sitting crooked.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_013.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_013.text: They refused that invitation until the cook laughed and admitted the request was a joke. Their free interval did not make every nearby task theirs. Qiu pressed the table leg lightly anyway, curious, then stopped before proposing a repair she had not been asked to undertake seriously. Yue admired the restraint. It took more effort for Qiu than it would have taken for someone less quick to see mechanisms everywhere. The cook slid a folded scrap under the leg himself and declared his kitchen qualified for another evening.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_014.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_014.text: On the quay, the sky had flattened to a dark blue gray. Qiu walked at Yue's pace without matching every step. She could look ahead, then return to the same stretch of boards. Yue did not ask her to perform slowness as proof of friendship.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_015.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_015.text: They named dry charcoal, swelling wood, a wet reference cord and the difference between rain on the apparatus and damp in the air. Their courtyard cover would protect against falling water if it stayed sound; it would not guarantee dry parts.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_016.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_016.text: Qiu paused at the fork in the quay. 'I dislike the way you leave a limit standing after you have made your point,' she said. Yue looked at the rain darkening the far water. 'I dislike the way you hear a limit as someone taking your work away.'

rival_cooperate_kitchen_017.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_017.text: The second afternoon began under steady rain. Yue arrived with a dry sleeve over her notes and found Qiu already looking at the courtyard cover. Su stood beside the low table with one hand on its frame. Water had gathered in the cloth's central sag overnight.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_018.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_018.text: Su supported the wet cover's edge with a spare board while Qiu lifted the sag away from the guide. Yue stood back from the water path and watched. A narrow dark patch marked the guide's upper surface. The charcoal packet remained dry in its box. One pan cord felt cool and damp where it had touched the cover. The apparatus was no longer in yesterday's dry condition. They could document the exposure and stop the affected comparison while deciding what work remained meaningful.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_019.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_019.text: Qiu wanted to wipe the guide and carry on. Yue asked whether a dry looking surface could hide swelling at the notch. Qiu knew the answer and resented hearing it. She pressed her lips together, then said, 'We can measure the opening before wiping.'

rival_cooperate_kitchen_020.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_020.text: The damp cord had another problem: it hung slightly longer than its paired cord. Qiu pointed out that a cool touch was not a measurement of moisture. Yue agreed and named only the observed length difference and the contact with the wet cover. They placed a dry wooden reference beside each unloaded pan. The near pan's rim sat lower than yesterday's marked position. Whether dampness, a slipped knot or both had caused it was still open. Rain gave them a candidate explanation, not permission to stop looking.

rival_cooperate_rain_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_001.text: The table could be moved under the loggia without lifting the fixture separately. Su called a facility attendant who already had responsibility for furniture. Qiu and Yue cleared the loose trays and stood outside the path. Yue was not asked to lend her shoulder because she had arrived to collaborate. The attendant rolled the table on its low casters, locked them and checked the floor beneath. Their cold apparatus traveled a few paces. That easy movement preserved the exposed condition instead of disguising it behind a complete dismantling.

rival_cooperate_rain_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_002.text: Yesterday's visitors could not all return. The repairer came with a patched rain cape; the porters were working elsewhere. Two new observers watched from the loggia entrance, shaking water from their sleeves before crossing the dry line. Qiu stated that yesterday's result did not automatically apply today.

rival_cooperate_rain_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_003.text: Yue could have let those admissions stand without her. She had also seen the cover and had not asked what a collected pool would weigh. 'I accepted it too,' she said. Qiu glanced at her. 'You don't need to take my share.' 'I am taking my own.' Su wrote the joint omission in a separate place from the mechanical observations. Responsibility for storage did not decide the cause of drag. It did decide whether they could tell the new audience a story in which rain alone had behaved badly.

rival_cooperate_rain_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_004.text: Under the loggia roof, Qiu tried the empty tongue with the beam removed from its path. It moved freely for the first half of travel, then rubbed. Yue watched the guide but did not apply a finger to force it open. The changed gap and the rubbing tongue were consistent with swelling or a shifted guide. Su asked them to check the fastenings before assuming the wood had swollen. One reversible tie had tightened on the damp side and pulled the guide slightly inward.

rival_cooperate_rain_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_005.text: They marked the tie's position before releasing it. When Qiu loosened the loop, the stiff paper passed farther through the opening but still stopped short of yesterday's free travel. The tie had contributed something; it did not explain everything they could see.

rival_cooperate_rain_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_006.text: The new observer in a blue coat suggested rubbing the tongue with oil. Qiu thanked him and declined to apply it during the comparison. Oil would add another surface condition, and they had not planned how to remove it cleanly. The man shrugged and said tools worked better when people stopped discussing them. Yue asked what his tool needed to do after it worked. 'Close the crate,' he said. 'Then you have a different question,' Qiu answered. Her sharpness returned, but the distinction was real.

rival_cooperate_rain_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_007.text: Su offered a spare guide cut from dry wood. Qiu wanted it, because it could restore an afternoon that seemed to be dissolving in front of them. Yue asked whether using it would test the exposed fixture or a rebuilt one. They could rebuild and label the change; they could not pretend it preserved yesterday's arrangement. Qiu stared at the spare. 'I know. I was asking for a second fixture.' Her voice sounded more tired than angry. Yue moved the spare to a separate tray rather than refusing it.

rival_cooperate_rain_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_008.text: They inspected the cord's knot through a magnifying lens held low on a stand. The knot had slipped toward the pan hook by a small visible distance. Qiu had marked its original tail length yesterday. Yue compared the present tail with the drawing.

rival_cooperate_rain_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_009.text: Qiu asked to perform the retie, since her fingers had made the first knot. Yue watched without taking over the failure. The new knot sat at the marked tail length, and the empty rim returned near yesterday's wooden reference. It remained slightly low at one edge because the hook had turned.

rival_cooperate_rain_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_010.text: A gust drove rain under the loggia edge. Su shifted the audience line back and placed a shallow basin beneath the drip. No visitor had to remain for the trial. The woman in the wet shawl left to protect a packet under her cloak.

rival_cooperate_rain_011.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_011.text: Qiu proposed one empty diagnostic closure using the rubbing guide. If it failed visibly, they would have a clear example to explain the stop. Yue said they already had evidence of changed drag, and forcing a closure could damage the tongue or hide the rubbing behind force. Su asked what useful question the diagnostic would answer. Qiu began, 'Whether it can still—' and stopped. Still close did not tell them what force it needed. They would need a declared way to observe that force before the motion became informative.

rival_cooperate_rain_012.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_012.text: They had no force instrument prepared for the low fixture, and improvising one would consume time without guaranteeing a clear comparison. Qiu refused to use Yue's shoulder as an informal gauge of effort. Yue appreciated that more than she expected. They could note that the free unloaded motion now rubbed under the original hand instruction. They could compare the gap at named points. Those were actual observations. The absent force measurement remained absent even if everyone believed the rubbing was stronger.

rival_cooperate_rain_013.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_013.text: A porter from another yard ducked under the roof and recognized Qiu. He called the fixture her new quick closer. Qiu said it was a joint trial with a current interruption. He laughed as though she were understating a success. 'You always get it done eventually.' Qiu's face closed. Yue saw how a flattering reputation could become a constraint. 'We have not demonstrated today's comparison,' she said. The porter looked from her to Qiu. Qiu nodded firmly. 'Eventually is not a result we can give you this afternoon.'

rival_cooperate_rain_014.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_014.text: The porter asked whether Yue was holding the work back. Qiu answered before the insult could spread. 'She is helping state the work accurately. I want a fast method another person can check. I do not get it by saying done when we have changed the parts.' Yue felt gratitude mixed with relief. Qiu was still her rival; the defense did not dissolve their technical disagreement. It did keep the audience from turning one woman's carefulness into the explanation for a failure both authors needed to understand.

rival_cooperate_rain_015.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_015.text: The dry spare guide let them ask a separate diagnostic question. Qiu laid it beside the damp guide and traced both openings on thin paper without forcing either piece. Yue kept the paper flat with her good hand while Qiu marked the visible edges.

rival_cooperate_rain_016.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_016.text: Yue suggested leaving the damp guide unloaded on its marked tray and checking its gap later in the afternoon. If its opening changed while the tie remained off, that would provide evidence about a changing part without their fingers forcing it. Qiu liked the idea because waiting now had a named purpose and endpoint. Su placed the tray away from the roof drip and wrote the time by the courtyard bell they could all hear. They made no claim about full drying. They wanted another observed state.

rival_cooperate_rain_017.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_017.text: With the altered pan assembly resting safely, Qiu saw charcoal on the back of her hand. She had brushed yesterday's example strip while moving the tray. The smudge did not affect the fixture, but it could confuse a person holding a new strip.

rival_cooperate_rain_018.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_018.text: The blue coated man had become quiet. He asked whether the two women could simply make a stronger guide tomorrow. Yue said a stronger guide might reduce distortion but change the apparatus. Qiu said a better storage cover might prevent this particular contact but would not prove every damp condition harmless. 'Then what can you say?' he asked. Qiu answered with unexpected patience: 'Today we can say where the original setup changed, and which planned question those changes prevent us from answering.'

rival_cooperate_rain_019.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_019.text: That answer sounded painfully modest even to Yue. She had wanted to see Qiu's method fail a fair test or survive it; neither had happened. Weather had made their authored fixture an uneven subject. The story of two rivals testing each other would be neater if rain selected a winner. The actual wet guide did not know which author had argued more persuasively. Yue touched the dry table edge and reminded herself that sharing a failure did not entitle her to make it dramatic.

rival_cooperate_rain_020.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_020.text: Su read yesterday's public sentence beside today's observations. People might quote the first sentence without its dry-condition limit. They might also hear that a wet guide interrupted the second afternoon and infer the latch had failed every normal use. Both distortions mattered. The authors needed to decide how to correct or qualify the public account. Su would preserve the facility record regardless. Their choice concerned how to address people who had seen, or might hear about, the trial beyond that record.

rival_cooperate_rain_021.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_021.text: Qiu preferred a direct public statement. Yue worried that a hurried statement would make an unexplained mechanical cause sound settled. Su said they could disclose the observed changes without claiming a complete cause. Another option was a private maker note exchanged by both authors while retaining a clear public stop notice; that would protect discussion still needing care but reach fewer listeners. A third was to withhold any comparative conclusion and offer the diagnostic observations alone, accepting that a rivalry count would remain blank.

rival_cooperate_rain_022.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_022.text: Yue asked Qiu what she feared most about a private note. 'A polite burial,' Qiu said. 'An author can tell herself the right people know while everyone else repeats the attractive version.' Qiu asked what Yue feared about a public correction. 'A useful uncertainty becoming a spectacle of confession,' Yue answered. Su looked toward the benches. 'You can state an error without selling your private selves with it. You can keep a discussion private without concealing the public limit. Each way still has a cost.'

rival_cooperate_rain_023.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_023.text: They drafted three short possible statements before choosing. One said the makers were revising a joint setup after observed wet contact and would circulate fuller details after the retest. One named the storage omission, the changed gap and the stopped comparison openly. The last reported the interruption and withheld the comparative claim altogether, offering only the diagnostic drawing for inspection. None would say that weather had proved an author wrong. None would erase yesterday's actual route result.

rival_cooperate_rain_024.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_024.text: A child appeared in the doorway carrying hot flatbread wrapped in cloth for Su. The steward shared it after paying the cook from her own purse. The warm pieces smelled of scallion and sesame. Qiu ate hers standing beside the drawing, crumbs carefully held over the cloth. Yue sat to rest her shoulder while reviewing the statements. An argument about public truth could coexist with pleasure in bread. They did not have to remain hungry to demonstrate seriousness or turn eating into a delay for which someone deserved blame.

rival_cooperate_rain_025.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_025.text: After the bell, they checked the damp guide's opening again with the same dry scrap at the same marked approach. It traveled a little farther. Qiu marked the new stopping depth. The guide had changed while unloaded, but the wood had not returned to yesterday's opening. Yue wrote changing during the pause, leaving the cause qualified. Su put the two outlines side by side. The observation gave them more to say, not a reason to postpone saying the current comparison remained interrupted.

rival_cooperate_rain_026.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_026.text: Qiu's braid had loosened near her neck. She retied it while Yue rested, keeping her hands away from the clean strips. The practical gesture made her look younger for a moment, then the familiar severity returned when she read the proposed statements. 'I won't have the private note call it an adjustment,' she said. Yue agreed. Adjustment could hide the failure to protect the setup. 'And the public version won't call the knot failure the whole failure,' Yue added. Qiu crossed out the offending phrase herself.

rival_cooperate_rain_027.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_027.text: The shared draft named the setup as jointly authored and stored under the facility arrangement. The latch proposal and stop-pin proposal kept their separate attribution. Storage responsibility did not rewrite authorship. Su's role stayed visible as the steward who had accepted the cover, moved the table and preserved the record. No one would be invented as a careless attendant to absorb embarrassment. The new porter, listening now without interruption, said he had never seen people divide blame so carefully. Qiu answered, 'We are dividing observations first.'

rival_cooperate_rain_028.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_028.text: Yue looked at the bright charcoal examples from yesterday beside the rain darkening the courtyard bricks. The choice would shape who heard the correction and how the two women worked through its incomplete cause. It would not change the observed gap, restore a lost comparison or reward them for honesty. Qiu laid her brush parallel to Yue's. The rival was ready to disagree again, but she would sign only words both women could defend. Su left the three drafts on the low table within Yue's comfortable reach.

rival_cooperate_correction.speaker: lin_yue
rival_cooperate_correction.text: The second afternoon had stopped the affected comparison. Yue now chose how they would address the public account while preserving that stop. A shared private maker note could hold their fuller discussion, with a visible public notice of the interruption. A public correction could name the joint storage omission and current observations directly. Withholding the comparative claim could foreground the diagnostic evidence and leave the contest unanswered. Each choice would lead to actual different communication and later limits, without changing the fixture's facts.

choices.text: Exchange a signed private maker note and post the clear public interruption notice.
Give a public correction naming the shared omission and the qualified observations.
Withhold the comparative claim and publish only the diagnostic evidence and its limits.

rival_cooperate_private_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_private_001.text: Yue chose the private maker note with a public interruption notice. Qiu checked that the notice would still say the comparative work had stopped because the setup's condition had changed. It would not merely announce a delay. Su copied that sentence onto a board at the entrance and read it to the remaining spectators. Anyone who had watched yesterday could understand that today's apparatus had not repeated yesterday's conditions. The fuller exchange between the makers would stay in their signed note until they agreed what was ready to circulate.

rival_cooperate_private_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_private_002.text: The private note was not a secret replacement for the facility record. Su's original observation sheet remained available under the ordinary inspection arrangement. Yue and Qiu moved to the quieter end of the loggia to discuss uncertainties without an audience turning every disagreement into a verdict. They named the wet cover contact, changed guide opening, tightened tie, slipped knot and partial change during the unloaded pause. Neither woman's private suspicion became an established cause because it was written away from other people's hearing.

rival_cooperate_private_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_private_003.text: Qiu wrote her account first. She admitted she had favored resuming after a wipe because she wanted the second afternoon to produce a usable closure series. Yue wrote that she had accepted the original cover and had not checked its shape under collected water. Both statements concerned their reasoning, not only the mechanism. Yue hesitated over whether to include them in a future public note. Qiu said, 'Keep them here for now. We can acknowledge the joint omission without inviting strangers to interpret our temperaments.'

rival_cooperate_private_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_private_004.text: They exchanged papers and read in silence. Yue found a sentence saying the pin system required dry storage. That was too broad: the observed damp contact had affected the shared guide and a pan cord, while the pin itself had not been shown to fail. Qiu accepted the correction. Qiu found a sentence saying her latch had remained sound. That too was too broad: the tongue rubbed under the original hand instruction. Yue crossed it out. Privacy had not freed either author from challenging a comforting phrase.

rival_cooperate_private_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_private_005.text: Su brought the two maker pages together with a simple cover sheet naming the public interruption notice. The note would preserve their technical discussion and current decisions; it would not certify the fixture for use. Qiu asked for separate signatures beneath their own accounts and a joint signature beneath the shared facts. Yue agreed. They could acknowledge one apparatus without pretending every recollection was identical. The form protected authorship where it mattered and cooperation where it existed. Su did not sign the makers' reasoning as her own.

rival_cooperate_private_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_private_006.text: The blue coated observer asked whether the private note meant there was something alarming to hide. Yue answered the question at the notice board. The parts were cold and isolated; the comparison had stopped. The makers were discussing causes not fully established. Qiu added that the available observation sheet showed the actual changes. They offered no account of Yue's shoulder beyond the ordinary operator limit already stated. The man read the notice again. 'I can tell my brother it did not prove weatherproof,' he said. Both women said yes.

rival_cooperate_private_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_private_007.text: A woman from yesterday returned late and saw only the board. She wanted to know whether she had misunderstood the dry-session work. Qiu told her that yesterday's result remained within its stated conditions, and that today's exposed setup had not supplied a comparable result.

rival_cooperate_private_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_private_008.text: The private conversation allowed Qiu to admit a fear she would not have placed on the public board. If every interruption became a correction in the square, people might remember only the failure and stop listening to ordinary improvements. Yue said concealment invited the same loss of trust by a different route. They did not solve the tension. They agreed their public stop notice had to remain plain enough that no later enthusiast could quote the private note as a successful comparison. Future circulation would require a jointly reviewed statement.

rival_cooperate_private_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_private_009.text: Before leaving the quiet corner, they wrote one unresolved question each for the third afternoon. Qiu asked whether a protected dry revised setup could be operated at the agreed short motion without unexplained rubbing. Yue asked whether the returned beam could be observed freely across two local checks without an operator's hidden support. Those questions could meet in one retest if the setup first passed inspection. They signed the note and kept matching copies. Nothing in the signatures obliged them to agree with a result not yet obtained.

rival_cooperate_private_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_private_010.text: At the notice board, Su added the third afternoon's intended retest and its condition: inspection could still stop it. The private maker note was complete for now, and the public knew the affected comparison had been interrupted. Qiu tucked her copy inside a dry sleeve and said, 'I will not call this a quiet success.' Yue replied, 'I will not call the quiet conversation a substitute for the notice.' Their choice had protected room for discussion while accepting the risk that a short notice might need careful explanation tomorrow.

rival_cooperate_public_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_public_001.text: Yue chose the public correction. Qiu set the charcoal strips aside and faced the chalk line with her hands empty. Su read the current interruption first so the correction would not delay the practical information. Then Qiu said the makers and steward had accepted a loose cover that collected rainwater and touched the guide. Yue named her own part in accepting it. Su named hers in the storage arrangement. Nobody presented the admission as proof of a mechanical cause beyond the observed contact.

rival_cooperate_public_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_public_002.text: Qiu showed the original and current guide outlines on the pale inspection board. Yue held the board at a comfortable low height while Su pointed to the marks. They explained that releasing a tightened tie had changed the gap partly, and that the unloaded guide had changed further during the pause. The complete cause remained unresolved. The slipped cord knot and rotated hook were separately observed. The audience had enough information to see why a dry-condition comparison could not simply continue, without being told every alteration had the same explanation.

rival_cooperate_public_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_public_003.text: The porter who admired Qiu tried to applaud the correction. She stopped him gently. 'You can thank us for stating it, but clapping will not improve the drawing.' The audience laughed, and the tension eased. Yue did not turn the laugh into a claim that everyone understood.

rival_cooperate_public_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_public_004.text: A visitor asked whether Yue's caution had predicted the rain failure. Yue answered no. She had questioned comparative conditions; she had not identified the sagging cover before rain. Qiu said the latch's quick motion had also not prevented their shared storage omission. The answer deprived each woman of a useful heroic story. Su noted the practical change for the next storage: a pitched loose cover supported clear of the guide, with a basin path beyond the apparatus. The improved arrangement would need inspection, not an announcement of invulnerability.

rival_cooperate_public_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_public_005.text: Another visitor asked whether the public correction meant both witness methods were useless. Qiu held up the example strips and explained the narrower observations they had made yesterday. Yue showed the pin's gap drawing. Each sign still had its named function. The exposed fixture now had changed conditions, which stopped the affected comparison. A useful sign could be insufficient for a broader claim. The visitor looked dissatisfied. He wanted a simple ranking. The women offered the distinctions anyway, resisting the easy choice between total vindication and total failure.

rival_cooperate_public_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_public_006.text: Su wrote the correction in short paragraphs and placed it beside the interruption notice. Yue and Qiu each checked the names beside contributed parts. The jointly revised fixture carried both names; Qiu's latch and Yue's pin retained their separate attribution. The correction did not assign Yue authorship of Qiu's proposal merely because she helped stop the retest. Nor did Qiu's public voice turn the entire apparatus into hers. They signed the shared statement at the same height on the page, an arrangement Qiu considered until she stopped considering it.

rival_cooperate_public_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_public_007.text: The bowl customer from yesterday had brought her father to see the trial. The older man listened from a dry seat Su found for him. He said his hands would prefer a short motion but his shed was always damp. Qiu answered that this apparatus had not shown it could serve his shed. She could describe the observed fault and the planned protected retest. He accepted the limit more readily than his daughter. 'Better to bring me a small promise I can hold,' he said. Qiu's face softened briefly.

rival_cooperate_public_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_public_008.text: Yue asked the audience not to add the older man's condition to their public statement. He had offered a personal example, not joined the trial as a subject. Su agreed, and the man nodded. The correction stayed about the fixture and the makers' omission. People could recognize why repeatable low force might matter without donating their private circumstances to an instrument record. Qiu thanked him in a sentence addressed to him alone. The daughter looked between the women with less appetite for choosing a winner.

rival_cooperate_public_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_public_009.text: Once the questions ended, Qiu sat down hard on her stool. 'That was slower than fixing the guide,' she said. Yue answered, 'And it fixed a different thing.' Qiu stared at the statement board. 'Some of them will still remember that I apologized for a latch.' 'Then our retest has to cite the corrected account precisely.' Neither expected the public to become a perfect archive. They could make an accurate account available, explain it to actual listeners and decline to improve it for the sake of a cleaner reputation.

rival_cooperate_public_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_public_010.text: They covered the correction with a transparent rain shield that stayed away from the paper. Su's facility original remained indoors; the board copy would be checked in the morning and replaced if damaged. The public correction had reached the people present and could be read by later visitors.

rival_cooperate_withhold_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_withhold_001.text: Yue chose to withhold the comparative claim and publish the diagnostic evidence alone. Qiu looked at the empty count column for a long moment. 'Then no one gets to convert the drawings into a contest result,' she said. Su wrote that limitation at the top of the public sheet. The first afternoon's route result remained whatever they had actually performed. The second afternoon supplied observations of an exposed, altered setup. The trial would not award a winner by arranging those unlike facts in neighboring columns.

rival_cooperate_withhold_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_withhold_002.text: They prepared the diagnostic page as a sequence of observed states. The covered guide had a changed gap; releasing the tightened tie partly changed it; an unloaded pause changed it further. The pan assembly had a slipped knot and turned hook, followed by declared corrections. Qiu drew arrows showing the order without labeling the whole sequence a solved cause. Yue added the locations of the observed wet contact. The result was a story of things actually inspected, with room left where inference had not become demonstration.

rival_cooperate_withhold_003.speaker: narrator
