rival_cooperate_withhold_003.text: At the audience line, Su explained that there would be no comparative conclusion from the affected session. Qiu showed the diagnostic drawing and answered mechanical questions. Yue described the stopping rule and the absent force measurement. The blue coated man said the page seemed to tell him everything except whether the catch was good. Qiu replied, 'It tells you why today's evidence cannot answer that question.' The answer hurt her to give. Yue could hear the effort and did not make it easier by saying goodness was unimportant.

rival_cooperate_withhold_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_withhold_004.text: The porter who knew Qiu asked whether they were avoiding a loss. Yue said a fair comparison could produce a loss, but this interrupted setup had not performed the same question under the same conditions. Qiu added that withholding the claim also withheld any victory she might have wanted from yesterday's attractive signs. They were not reserving praise while discarding fault. Su kept the comparative spaces visibly blank. A blank space could be honest evidence of an unperformed question, provided its owner did not later fill it by memory.

rival_cooperate_withhold_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_withhold_005.text: The remaining visitors could inspect the example strips and the gap drawings during the pause. Qiu made sure no one handled the actual moving parts. The bowl customer's father looked closely at the changed guide outline and said his own box lids swelled after rain. Qiu acknowledged the resemblance without claiming the same cause fully explained this guide. The old man smiled. 'I can recognize a neighbor without marrying him.' Yue laughed. Qiu looked surprised, then laughed too. A mundane analogy had made a qualified answer easier to hear.

rival_cooperate_withhold_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_withhold_006.text: They did not publish the makers' private motives for stopping or continuing. The public page named the joint storage omission and the actual diagnostic facts, because those belonged to the account. It did not tell a reader that Qiu was impatient or Yue overly cautious. Their personalities could explain a conversation but would not substitute for inspecting the wood. Su asked both women to remove one adjective from the draft. Qiu removed unfortunate. Yue removed predictable. The page became less satisfying as a story and more precise as evidence.

rival_cooperate_withhold_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_withhold_007.text: Qiu proposed that the third afternoon also remain diagnostic, with no attempt to rank the witnesses by count. Yue agreed that a protected revised setup could test stated observations and instructions. The original broad comparison would remain withheld. They could still learn whether the joint fixture worked within its actual declared conditions. Qiu wanted the distinction printed plainly before the retest so nobody would hear a successful protected closure as a delayed victory in an unchanged contest. Yue wrote that sentence and asked Qiu to check it.

rival_cooperate_withhold_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_withhold_008.text: A child read the large heading aloud and asked what withheld meant. Qiu crouched at a distance from the parts and said, 'It means we have not earned the answer we wanted to give.' Yue added that they had earned some smaller observations by actually making them. The child considered the blank column. 'Like leaving a meal place for someone who isn't here?' 'Yes,' Qiu said, 'except nobody should pretend the empty place has eaten.' Su smiled into her sleeve, and the child went to find his mother.

rival_cooperate_withhold_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_withhold_009.text: The diagnostic sheet drew fewer spectators than a contest tally might have drawn. One visitor left when he heard there would be no winner. Qiu watched him go without altering the heading. The older man stayed to ask about the low latch motion. Yue demonstrated it empty only after declaring the revised guide setup, then returned the beam to rest. The demonstration was not a counted retest. It let a person see the proposed movement while leaving the unperformed comparative question exactly where it belonged.

rival_cooperate_withhold_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_withhold_010.text: At the end of the afternoon, Su preserved the diagnostic original and posted a copy beside the interruption notice. Qiu crossed through the unused second-session comparison box rather than leaving a tempting empty line without explanation. Yue checked that the crossing did not obscure the reason. Their choice had changed the third afternoon's purpose: they would test a limited joint fixture and report its observations, while the larger comparative claim stayed withheld. They left with less chance of a triumphant headline and more clarity about what could honestly happen next.

rival_cooperate_recovery_entry.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recovery_entry.text: The communication they had actually chosen was complete for the second afternoon. Before planning the protected retest, Su opened the first afternoon's route sheet. It mattered whether they had divided familiar duties, exchanged revised methods or stopped the original comparison for diagnostics. Rain did not turn those histories into one generic successful trial. Their next preparation would use the instructions and limits supported by the work they had truly performed.

rival_cooperate_recover_divide_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_divide_001.text: Their divided-duty sheet showed familiar operators, revised settling language and no demonstrated transfer to new hands. Qiu could not cite a successful exchange she had only proposed. Yue brought the pin instruction card forward. 'Before tomorrow's retest, you should try this empty if we want to claim the instructions are clear.' Qiu agreed to an empty rehearsal, kept separate from the affected comparative series. She read seat to the line, release and inspect the free gap. The wording now had a collar drawn beside it.

rival_cooperate_recover_divide_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_divide_002.text: Qiu seated the dry spare pin while Yue watched from the audience side. The scratch line was difficult to see under the loggia shadow, just as the first afternoon had warned. Su brought the pale board closer. Qiu asked whether her fingers would be expected to hold the pin while someone read it. Yue said no and added a release instruction in larger writing. Familiar division had concealed how easily that detail could vanish when the operator changed. The rehearsal found it without manufacturing a new comparison count.

rival_cooperate_recover_divide_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_divide_003.text: Yue tried Qiu's empty latch instruction with the dry spare guide on a separate marked base. Her good hand could slide the tongue from the low rest, but the command close lightly remained ambiguous. Qiu watched her hesitate and replaced it with a described hand position and short travel.

rival_cooperate_recover_divide_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_divide_004.text: The first afternoon's divided duties would remain divided in the protected retest, because transfer had not received a planned series. They could include the empty rehearsals in the preparation record and say instructions had been revised after another reader tried them. They could not announce general interchangeability. Qiu thought the limit sounded timid, then read her own description of the bouncing tongue. A comfortable inventor could still depart from her motion. Yue said familiar hands were a condition to be shown, not a guarantee to be worshipped.

rival_cooperate_recover_divide_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_divide_005.text: They rebuilt the joint fixture with the dry spare guide, marked tie positions and corrected pan assembly. Qiu handled the latch; Yue checked the pin. Su recorded the rebuild as a revised setup. A cord clip held the storage cover clear without touching a moving part, and its removal was demonstrated before any closure. The facility attendant returned the wet guide to its tray for continued observation. The old part would not be quietly discarded just because a dry spare made the apparatus pleasant again.

rival_cooperate_recover_divide_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_divide_006.text: Qiu laid the original divided-duty sheet beside tomorrow's empty result page. The new page named the revised guide and familiar operators. Yue added the two-tap settling aid. Their later conclusion would be narrower than the first plan: current behavior of a protected revised joint fixture under the declared small loads. Qiu drew a small line between preparation and result. That line would stop an empty instructional rehearsal from inflating the counted work. Yue found herself trusting the care with which her rival now made the inconvenient distinctions visible.

rival_cooperate_recover_divide_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_divide_007.text: Before they left, they checked the table height and trays again rather than assuming a rebuild preserved the reach. Yue's low pin tray had shifted outward while the spare base was moved. She corrected it with Qiu watching. The change protected her shoulder and kept the declared hand position true.

rival_cooperate_recover_divide_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_divide_008.text: The protected plan on this route retained familiar divided duties and revised transfer instructions supported only by empty rehearsal. No full exchanged-method series had occurred. Qiu and Yue signed those actual limits and gave Su the original plan page. Their own copies went into separate dry sleeves. The second afternoon ended with the wet guide still changing slowly on its tray. It did not know which route they had chosen. The people did, and tomorrow's report would have to remember it.

rival_cooperate_recover_swap_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_swap_001.text: Their exchanged-method sheet showed revised cards, a collar, thumb rest and lift tab. The rain recovery could not quietly revert to Qiu's original bare tongue and still call it the transferred method. Qiu arranged the three removable guides on the table. Yue checked their positions against the drawing. The collar had stayed dry, the thumb rest loop had been removed for storage and the lift tab's paper sleeve had curled slightly. Each item needed inspection before the third afternoon could repeat that revised arrangement.

rival_cooperate_recover_swap_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_swap_002.text: They flattened the sleeve away from the charcoal contact area and checked the lift tab's clearance under the pale board. Qiu resisted replacing the tab simply because a fresh one would look cleaner. The current tab had no observed tear or contact; it could remain if its clearance matched the drawing. Yue agreed. A precaution did not need to become a ritual of discarding sound parts. They marked the inspection result and put the tab aside until the rebuilt guide was ready.

rival_cooperate_recover_swap_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_swap_003.text: Qiu seated Yue's collared pin on the dry spare base. She could feel the collar without pushing against the beam. Yue tried the latch thumb rest with her good hand and reported a comfortable short motion. Su separated these empty rehearsals from tomorrow's series. The transferred method had revised again through the guide rebuild, though its low hand aids remained the same. Qiu wanted to say restoration; Yue suggested rebuilt setup. They chose rebuilt because it preserved the fact that the wet guide had not returned to its first condition.

rival_cooperate_recover_swap_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_swap_004.text: The thumb rest loop returned to its marked place with the knot outside the pan path. Qiu showed the audience side even though no audience was present. She had learned that a view from the operator's stool was not enough. Yue checked the pin gap from Su's future viewing place. The two women each inspected the other's aid as well as their own familiar proposal. Exchange had given them a reason to understand those foreign little parts. Neither had become a specialist with authority over every instrument in the yard.

rival_cooperate_recover_swap_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_swap_005.text: The corrected pan assembly hung near its reference after the knot and hook changes. Qiu proposed exchanging the whole assembly during the later repeat, as already planned. Yue agreed only if the hook clearances were shown first. Su wrote the sequence on the current page rather than trusting yesterday's corrected card to describe today's cord. Their retest could examine the protected rebuilt fixture in transferred hands. It could not erase the soaked exposure or prove the same method useful in an uncontrolled damp shed.

rival_cooperate_recover_swap_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_swap_006.text: Yue rehearsed reading the charcoal strip with the lift tab. The pale backing made the narrow rub visible without a raised reach. Qiu rehearsed reporting the pin gap before inspecting Yue's strip. They retained the separation of spoken reports so one did not pull the other into agreement. Su tapped twice at the declared comfortable pace. The sequence looked slower than Qiu's first private motion and faster than a long conversation after every closure. Qiu said, 'I can defend this kind of fast, if it works.'

rival_cooperate_recover_swap_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_swap_007.text: Their protected plan preserved the actual transferred-method history: revised guides, clarified cards and stopped or uncertain attempts kept in the sheet. Qiu did not count only the successful runs when explaining what the first exchange had shown. Yue did not count every revision as evidence that Qiu's latch had been fundamentally wrong. They had a more usable shared arrangement and a record of what forced it to change. Those facts could coexist. Su checked the cover support while they reviewed the new inspection order.

rival_cooperate_recover_swap_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_swap_008.text: The route ended the second afternoon ready for a protected rebuilt test in exchanged hands. Its instruction transfer had actual recorded attempts, unlike a mere proposal for swapping someday. The broader claim remained bounded by the communication choice already made. Qiu placed the two original cards beneath the revised ones so tomorrow's audience could ask what changed. Yue rested her shoulder before fastening her satchel. Their new confidence was qualified enough to be useful: they knew more about the sequence, and knew the places where it might still stop.

rival_cooperate_recover_stop_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_stop_001.text: Their first afternoon sheet contained diagnostic examples and an expressly unperformed comparison. Su opened it to the drawings of moving passages and ambiguous signs. Qiu looked at the empty count column without trying to fill it from memory. The protected retest could use the clearer pin collar, inspection backing and two-tap settling aid they had developed. It would be their first planned loaded series under those agreed terms, provided tomorrow's inspection passed. Yesterday's demonstrations could explain the setup but could not supply its missing comparison history.

rival_cooperate_recover_stop_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_stop_002.text: They practiced the sequence empty on the dry spare base. Yue would inspect the pin and Qiu would operate the latch, since they had not completed a planned transfer series. The empty practice showed Qiu forgetting to return her free hand to the low rest after checking a strip. She noticed when Su paused the taps. Qiu set her hand back and added the step to the card. Stopping the original comparison had made room for clearer terms; it had not made either operator immune to an ordinary omission.

rival_cooperate_recover_stop_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_stop_003.text: The collared pin sat beside a free gap, and the pale backing made the charcoal categories visible. Qiu arranged the examples from the first afternoon in their sleeve. She wanted the audience to see why a narrow mark did not by itself prove settling. Yue wanted the moving-beam drawings visible beside them. They built the explanation around the observations they had truly made. It would be easier to say our method passed earlier tests, but earlier diagnostics had not asked the same planned loaded question.

rival_cooperate_recover_stop_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_stop_004.text: The dry spare guide and corrected pan assembly formed a revised joint fixture. Qiu marked the tie positions on the sketch. Yue checked the unloaded pan clearances with her arm supported. Su recorded the replacement and the changed cord knot. The two authors could still inspect the wet guide later; its continuing change belonged to a separate diagnostic line. A first counted series on the rebuilt setup would not become a first series on the original dry setup merely because the apparatus carried the same familiar beam.

rival_cooperate_recover_stop_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_stop_005.text: Qiu said, 'We have stopped two afternoons and still have one.' Yue answered, 'We stopped a comparison twice. We did not do nothing.' Qiu laid a finger beside the drawings. 'I know. I want the distinction to lead to an action now.' Yue agreed. They wrote the third afternoon's sequence compactly: inspect, rehearse empty, declare the loaded series, perform the bounded attempts, pause and repeat with the declared exchange. Each stage had a stopping condition. Clarity had to serve actual work or it would become another way to avoid risk.

rival_cooperate_recover_stop_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_stop_006.text: They agreed to keep the empty rehearsal short. A defect found there would stop and redirect the loaded series; an uneventful rehearsal would let it proceed. They would not keep inventing harmless demonstrations until the afternoon expired. Su pointed to the finishing time. It mattered as a practical boundary, especially because Yue's shoulder needed its rest and Qiu had another accepted obligation afterward. Their shared free interval belonged to the trial they had chosen, not to an endless search for the feeling of readiness.

rival_cooperate_recover_stop_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_stop_007.text: Qiu tested the storage support by pouring a little water onto the cover while the fixture stood safely away on its dry table. The water ran into the designated basin instead of sagging in the center. This tested that little cover arrangement separately; it did not certify weatherproofing for the instrument. Yue checked the support's low removal path before the cover went over the fixture. They had finally converted a storage argument into a visible cold action. Su kept the test water well away from the charcoal packet.

rival_cooperate_recover_stop_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_stop_008.text: The route closed with a protected revised fixture and a plan for its first loaded series under clarified local terms. It retained the unperformed original comparison and the diagnostic history that had led here. Qiu could dislike those blanks without altering them.

rival_cooperate_third_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_001.text: The last afternoon was bright enough to throw the loggia pillars into sharp relief. A film of rainwater still lay in the courtyard's brick joints, but the protected table was dry where Su inspected it. The cover support stood clear of the guide.

rival_cooperate_third_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_002.text: The old exposed guide had changed again on its diagnostic tray. The stiff paper now traveled nearly to yesterday's first dry mark, though its far edge still caught. Qiu showed the observation to Yue, then set the old part aside. It was not being used in the rebuilt fixture. They would retain its history without dragging its unresolved cause into every current action. Su drew the final observed gap on the diagnostic page. Returning toward an old shape was not the same as having proved why the shape changed.

rival_cooperate_third_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_003.text: Yue tested her comfortable low reach with an empty hand. Her shoulder remained within its familiar restriction; the trial had not healed it or granted an exception. Qiu asked where the pause should fall and accepted the answer without bargaining for a few extra attempts. Su placed water cups within easy reach. The interval belonged to actual people as well as an instrument. Their operators could be identified and their limits stated without turning the careful setup into a personal medical exhibition.

rival_cooperate_third_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_004.text: The audience included the older man, his daughter and the repairer. The blue coated observer arrived after the inspection and was told what he had missed. Two new visitors chose to watch only the demonstration. Qiu explained the setup as a protected rebuilt fixture, named the dry spare guide and showed the corrected pan assembly.

rival_cooperate_third_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_005.text: Su gave the two taps for the empty rehearsal. The designated operators followed the roles prepared by their earlier route. The tongue traveled without unexplained rubbing, the pin sat to its collar or line and the pans remained clear of the mat. They did not count the rehearsal as a loaded success. Qiu smiled at the quiet motion, then made herself read the stopping conditions aloud. Her pleasure could begin the work without finishing its judgment. Yue found that discipline more convincing than a solemn face would have been.

rival_cooperate_third_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_006.text: For the first recorded attempt, the near named button went into its pan and the paired button into the far pan according to the current card. The beam moved through a small arc and came back toward level. Hands withdrew to the low rests.

rival_cooperate_third_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_007.text: The second recorded attempt looked similar until the latch operator felt a slight interruption before the final seat. The run stopped and the buttons came out along the safe low path. Qiu looked first at the guide tie. Yue looked at the pan clearance. Neither found a visible contact there. Su asked whether the charcoal strip's free end had moved. It had slipped closer to the tongue entrance. A paper edge, not necessarily the guide, might have caught. They marked the interrupted attempt without naming that possibility a proved cause.

rival_cooperate_third_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_008.text: During the declared pause, they inspected the strip holder. Its reversible loop had turned a little on the smooth table rail. Qiu had focused on keeping the guide tie marked and overlooked the holder's relation to the tongue. Yue drew a second mark on the rail beside the holder. They returned it to its recorded position and tested empty with a fresh strip. The tongue moved cleanly. That observation supported continuing under a corrected holder position, while the interrupted loaded attempt remained part of the record.

rival_cooperate_third_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_009.text: The repairer asked whether the fresh strip had simply been more cooperative. Qiu showed the unused strip from the interrupted attempt beside the fresh one. Its edge had a crease near the holder, which might account for the catch. They could see a crease; they could not reconstruct the exact moment of contact. Yue said the correction made the current arrangement explicit and the retest could show current behavior. It did not solve every detail of the interrupted attempt. The repairer nodded and kept his question in the public sheet.

rival_cooperate_third_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_010.text: The third recorded attempt used the declared holder position and a fresh named strip. The sequence produced a free observed gap and narrow single rub, with clear pans and hands returned to the rests. Su wrote the reports separately before joining them in the result line.

rival_cooperate_third_011.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_011.text: They paused long enough for Yue to rest without a pin in her hand. Qiu drank water and sat rather than hovering over the apparatus. The older man asked whether he might inspect a clean and a rubbed strip close up during the pause.

rival_cooperate_third_012.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_012.text: Before the repeat, they exchanged the whole named pan assemblies as planned. Both hooks and cords moved with their pans. The empty height and clearance were checked under the current references. The near pan now had a slightly different tilt that remained clear of the mat. They documented it rather than leveling it invisibly. Yue's low reach remained comfortable after the exchange. Qiu repeated the hand instruction for the audience. Changing a load's side was an action with conditions, not a magical way to cancel every asymmetry.

rival_cooperate_third_013.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_013.text: The fourth recorded attempt closed cleanly under those declared exchanged assemblies. The fifth did too. Su's two taps stayed part of the same local settling rule. Qiu wanted to make a sixth attempt to see whether the pair could repeat once more, but the planned series had reached its end. Yue asked what new question the extra run would answer. Qiu considered the nearly empty charcoal packet. 'Mostly whether I can make the ending feel less fragile,' she said. She left the sixth space blank and labeled it unperformed.

rival_cooperate_third_014.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_014.text: They now had four completed observations satisfying the current local criteria and one interrupted attempt, followed by a declared correction and empty check before continuation. The current conditions included a protected rebuilt fixture, named small loads, actual route roles, visible references and local settling taps. No wider qualification or weatherproof claim followed from the count. Qiu said the short motion had proved possible repeatedly here. Yue agreed, and added that the signs remained partial witnesses to a sequence rather than guarantees carried away from it.

rival_cooperate_third_015.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_015.text: The older man's daughter asked which author had won. Qiu rested a palm on the edge of the table, outside the parts. 'The question changed when we had to rebuild. We can report what the joint fixture did.' Yue explained that separate contributions retained their names and that the correction choice had already limited how the comparative account would be used. The daughter looked at her father. He said he would rather know the short movement and its conditions than choose a woman to congratulate for defeating the other.

rival_cooperate_third_016.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_016.text: Yue expected to feel vindicated by the stopped attempt. Instead she felt glad they had found it before pretending the holder could not shift. Qiu expected to feel robbed by the revision. Instead she could see the short movement repeated without her private instinct being the only witness. Neither reaction made the earlier argument foolish. It showed what a real trial could change in people who had enough room to admit an inconvenient thing. The apparatus remained a small cold apparatus; the changed relationship was theirs to consider.

rival_cooperate_third_017.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_017.text: Su read the current result against the earlier communication page. That page determined what they owed listeners now. A private maker note required a matching clear follow-up notice and a careful decision about further circulation. A public correction required a public result citing the rebuilt setup and the stopped attempt. A withheld comparative claim required a diagnostic report that did not quietly declare a winner after all. They had performed the same last afternoon's actions, but their actual promises about its account were different.

rival_cooperate_result_route.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_route.text: Their last-afternoon sheet was complete. It held the actual completed observations, the interrupted attempt, the declared holder correction and the unperformed extra run. Su opened the communication record beside it. The chosen second-afternoon account would decide the form of the follow-up. Yue and Qiu would not invent an earlier public correction, private note or withheld claim simply because one form now seemed easier to explain.

rival_cooperate_result_private_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_private_001.text: They returned to the signed private maker note. Qiu added the last afternoon's record in her own hand, including the interrupted attempt and unperformed extra run. Yue added the current limits and checked the wording against the public interruption notice. Their fuller technical discussion could remain private, but the public needed a clear follow-up that the protected rebuilt fixture had supplied bounded observations. They drafted that notice together without claiming the original exposed setup had resumed unchanged.

rival_cooperate_result_private_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_private_002.text: The follow-up notice stated four completed local observations and one stopped attempt, followed by a declared holder correction. It named the protected rebuilt arrangement and declined a weatherproof claim. Qiu wanted the short motion mentioned; Yue agreed because the current sequence had actually used it. Yue wanted the partial witnesses described; Qiu agreed because neither sign alone had carried the sequence. They did not publish every candid private sentence. The actual public result was complete enough to prevent the private discussion from becoming a hidden substitute.

rival_cooperate_result_private_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_private_003.text: Su posted the follow-up beside the earlier interruption board and preserved its original with the facility record. A visitor who had seen only the short notice could now understand what had happened next. The signed maker note remained with its two authors and steward under the stated arrangement. Qiu asked Yue whether they should circulate a fuller joint article later. Yue said that would require a new reviewed text. The possible future article remained a proposal, not another achievement quietly added to today's work.

rival_cooperate_result_private_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_private_004.text: The private route closed with a public interrupted-session notice, a public bounded follow-up and an actual signed maker exchange. Its strength was room for candid technical disagreement without exposing every private motive. Its cost was that the short public pages needed careful plain wording. Qiu accepted that privacy had worked only because it carried a real public limit beside it. Yue accepted that candid private discussion could improve the shared account without being a concealment. They set those pages aside before choosing what their relationship should become.

rival_cooperate_result_public_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_public_001.text: They returned to the public correction board. Qiu read the storage omission again before describing the protected rebuilt retest. Yue showed the current guide and holder marks. The new result did not revoke the correction; it followed it. Four observations met the current criteria, one attempt stopped and an extra run remained unperformed. The audience could see how the changed arrangement and declared correction made the later action different from the interrupted rainy session.

rival_cooperate_result_public_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_public_002.text: A new visitor asked why a successful final afternoon still included the word failure on the earlier page. Su said the storage omission remained true. Qiu explained that correcting a defect did not make its earlier occurrence imaginary. Yue added that the interrupted holder attempt remained part of today's record too. The visitor smiled uneasily. 'Your success carries a lot of luggage.' Qiu replied, 'It carries the parts someone else needs to know before repeating it.' The repairer nodded at that more readily than he had at their first sketch.

rival_cooperate_result_public_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_public_003.text: They signed the public follow-up and left it beside the correction under the rain shield. The older man thanked them for refusing to promise the method for his damp shed. Qiu invited him to inspect the short empty movement once more, with its present setup declared.

rival_cooperate_result_public_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_public_004.text: The public route closed with a visible correction and a visible bounded retest result. Its strength was that listeners could follow the revision without relying on a private exchange. Its cost was the time and vulnerability of answering a public misunderstanding directly. Qiu had endured that cost and kept the separate authorship clear. Yue had acknowledged her own omission without adopting a superior narrator's position over the failure. They left the signed board behind them and turned toward a choice the instrument sheet could not make.

rival_cooperate_result_withhold_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_withhold_001.text: They returned to the diagnostic sheet whose heading withheld the comparative claim. Qiu added the protected rebuilt sequence as a new observed state, with four qualifying local observations, one stopped attempt and a declared holder correction. Yue checked that the new paragraph did not call the repeat a victory for either witness. The earlier broad comparison stayed withheld. Their small loaded series could still show a short workable motion here, because that was an action they had actually performed under stated conditions.

rival_cooperate_result_withhold_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_withhold_002.text: The repairer asked whether withholding the comparison now seemed unnecessary. Qiu said no. The changed fixture, route history and interrupted conditions still prevented the original simple ranking. Yue agreed that the diagnostic work had produced a useful current result, not the answer they had refused to invent yesterday. Su crossed no blank into a winning count. They left the unused comparative space visibly explained. The absence had become part of the final account rather than a temporary embarrassment somebody would repair with a triumphant sentence.

rival_cooperate_result_withhold_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_withhold_003.text: The blue coated man read the completed diagnostic page and said it finally gave him something he could use: an example of what to inspect before blaming his own damp crate catch. Qiu told him their guide's exact cause remained partly unresolved. He nodded. 'I can inspect mine anyway.' Yue appreciated the modest transfer. A public observation could prompt another person's sensible question without granting the makers authority over his crate. Qiu showed him the drawing rather than prescribing a repair to a tool she had never seen.

rival_cooperate_result_withhold_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_withhold_004.text: The withheld route closed with an actual diagnostic account and a limited protected-setup result, while its original comparative claim remained unanswered. Its strength was refusing to turn unlike sessions into a ranking. Its cost was leaving the desired contest without a winner even after useful work.

rival_cooperate_future_scene_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_future_scene_001.text: Once the facility original was complete, Su checked the parts against their return list before final dismantling. The facility grant covered only its recorded space, supply and witness costs; its unused balance stayed with Su for the recorded return. No copper entered either woman's purse as a wage or prize. The fixture stayed as an isolated demonstration apparatus, not a commissioned instrument certified for use. Yue and Qiu kept their permitted copies, which described the work actually done. Their standing and cultivation remained where they had been when they arrived.

rival_cooperate_future_scene_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_future_scene_002.text: Qiu asked Yue to walk to the rain gauge station before leaving. The little station stood by the quay with a clear view of the current sky. They were not taking over its work or reading its instrument as specialists. They simply liked the quieter path beside it.

rival_cooperate_future_scene_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_future_scene_003.text: Yue admitted she had arrived wanting Qiu to concede a hidden cost. Qiu said she had wanted Yue to stop making caution sound like ownership of the truth. They had each received something less satisfying and more useful than a surrender. The other woman could recognize a real defect and still retain a stubborn preference. Qiu preferred short repeatable motion; Yue preferred an endpoint that disclosed what remained uncertain. Their shared fixture had shown the preferences could correct one another when neither tried to erase the other's name.

rival_cooperate_future_scene_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_future_scene_004.text: They stood beneath the gauge station roof while a few last drops fell from its edge. Qiu said another joint session could compare written instructions with a willing new operator, under a separately agreed safe setup and actual free interval. That was a possible future study, requiring its own permission, scope and schedule. It had not occurred today. Yue could keep Qiu as a rival without accepting the study; she could offer to develop it together; or she could end their shared instrument work with the present account complete.

rival_cooperate_future.speaker: lin_yue
rival_cooperate_future.text: The three-afternoon trial was over. Its actual records would remain true whichever relationship Yue chose next. She could keep a bounded rivalry, sharing public corrections while developing separate methods. She could offer future collaboration on a newly agreed limited study, leaving every booking and term to be confirmed. She could end their joint work respectfully and retain only this completed account. Qiu waited for an answer that neither a clean strip nor a free pin gap could supply.

choices.text: Keep a bounded rivalry and develop separate methods with honest public correction.
Offer future collaboration on a separately agreed limited instruction study.
End the joint work respectfully and retain this completed account.

rival_cooperate_rivals_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rivals_001.text: Yue chose to keep a bounded rivalry. Qiu looked relieved and annoyed, a combination Yue was beginning to recognize. 'You don't want to make a shop together,' Qiu said. 'I want to see what you make when I am not at your elbow.' Qiu considered the prospect.

rival_cooperate_rivals_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rivals_002.text: They named the practical boundary. The joint fixture's drawings and correction account would retain their actual attribution. Each woman could develop a separate proposal using her own contribution and the ordinary lessons of the shared trial. Neither could publish the other's private maker words merely because the rivalry might benefit from them. Public observations already issued could be cited with their limits. Qiu wanted that distinction in writing. Yue did too. Competition felt cleaner when it did not require stealing intimacy from a moment of shared embarrassment.

rival_cooperate_rivals_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rivals_003.text: Qiu proposed that if either published a new claim citing the joint trial, she would show the relevant wording to the other before circulation when practicable. Yue accepted this as their intended courtesy, not a power to veto every independent work. An urgent public correction to an actual misstatement could still be made plainly. Su, when they returned to the loggia, helped them phrase the boundary without inventing a new institutional rule. The facility was not appointing two permanent judges over one another's careers.

rival_cooperate_rivals_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rivals_004.text: The arrangement left their technical disagreement alive. Qiu still thought Yue underestimated the value of a short repeatable sequence under modest declared conditions. Yue still thought Qiu too readily heard incomplete evidence as an obstacle to be overcome by another attempt. They could challenge those habits in concrete work rather than rehearsing accusations detached from an apparatus. Qiu said, 'Next time I want a result you cannot call merely possible here.' Yue replied, 'Then give it a question whose conditions can actually travel.' Qiu grinned.

rival_cooperate_rivals_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rivals_005.text: Su asked whether the rivalry required reserving another afternoon. Both women said no. Their present trial was complete; future opportunities would need their own dates and terms. Qiu had an accepted obligation after the current interval, and Yue's existing bookings remained in force. A spirited promise to meet again could not spend somebody else's calendar. They wrote no new acceptance. The rivalry continued as a relationship and a preference for honest challenge, without secretly becoming another performed course of work.

rival_cooperate_rivals_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rivals_006.text: At the low table, they dismantled the removable guides and showed Su their marked return state. The beam, pans and spare guide went back to facility storage. Each woman retained her permitted authored drawing and the joint summary. Qiu offered Yue the clean unused charcoal strip as a keepsake, then changed her mind. 'That would make the last unperformed run look sentimental.' Yue laughed. The strip returned to the facility packet. Their memory did not need a borrowed object quietly reassigned at the end of an afternoon.

rival_cooperate_rivals_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rivals_007.text: On the quay, Qiu stopped beside a stall selling roasted beans. She bought a small paper twist from her own purse and offered some to Yue. The purchase had nothing to do with the grant. Yue took a few while holding her satchel close enough to spare the shoulder.

rival_cooperate_rivals_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rivals_008.text: A boatman recognized the two women from the public bench. He asked whether they were friends now. Qiu answered, 'We are still inclined to argue.' Yue added, 'With better records.' The boatman looked disappointed by the lack of a simple transformation. Qiu offered him a bean and received a joke about charging tolls on arguments. They continued along the wet boards laughing. A relationship could grow more cordial without becoming identical to friendship, partnership or enmity. The choice had left room for those distinctions to develop later.

rival_cooperate_rivals_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rivals_009.text: When they parted, Qiu said she would keep the old first sketch. Its impossible straight alignment reminded her where the public question had begun. Yue said she would keep the revised card with the hidden adjectives removed. Each chose an object from her own permitted copies. Neither claimed the other had finally learned the one correct way to work. The rival remained tall, impatient and capable of a quick generous answer; Yue remained patient, limited by her shoulder and capable of wanting a contest more than she had admitted.

rival_cooperate_rivals_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rivals_010.text: Yue reached the receiving loggia with a completed joint trial record and a chosen continuing rivalry. She had no new partnership, no booked instruction study and no claim that the original comparison had been performed in whichever form sounded best. The route's actual communication pages stayed attached to its actual work. Her purse contained what it had after her own ordinary purchases, not a prize. The return to the receiving desk would let her consider another bounded next step with the same honest calendar and the same retained shoulder.

rival_cooperate_joint_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_joint_001.text: Yue offered future collaboration on a limited instruction study. Qiu did not answer with a triumphant handshake. She asked what Yue meant by collaboration. 'A new question, agreed before a new apparatus,' Yue said. 'Whether written instructions can travel to a willing operator without our private touches.' Qiu nodded slowly. 'And short motion remains a real aim, not a temptation you tolerate.' Yue agreed. Her own aim remained visible verification. The proposed partnership began by naming the preferences it would need to preserve.

rival_cooperate_joint_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_joint_002.text: They could not recruit a passerby at the quay and claim the study had begun. A willing new operator would need a clearly described role, appropriate safe setup, freedom to stop and an actual suitable interval. Their small cold fixture might serve a revised study, but they would need to agree its limits again. Qiu wrote proposed, not scheduled at the top of a scrap. Yue liked seeing the word from her hand. An intention could be serious without borrowing the false solidity of an already accepted booking.

rival_cooperate_joint_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_joint_003.text: Qiu proposed alternating authorship of the instruction draft. Yue suggested writing separate drafts first, then comparing where each reader got lost. The plans were different enough to require discussion. They did not settle it by naming one woman the patient editor and the other the fast inventor. Qiu could edit a careful phrase; Yue could make a decisive mechanism change. Their actual joint trial had shown both. The future collaboration would preserve those possibilities instead of trapping each woman in the role her rival had first expected.

rival_cooperate_joint_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_joint_004.text: They returned to Su and asked for an enquiry form for later space, without claiming entitlement to another grant. The steward gave them an ordinary availability page. They could inspect possible dates after checking their accepted obligations. No room was booked by carrying the page away. No supplier was engaged. Su wrote that the present facility balance remained separate from a future request. Qiu said they would fund or request the next study under its own terms, if the idea reached an agreed plan.

rival_cooperate_joint_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_joint_005.text: Yue and Qiu each copied the proposed question. It included a protected isolated low-load fixture, written instructions, publicly inspectable local criteria and a deliberately limited number of attempts. The exact parts, operator and dates remained unresolved. They marked those open items rather than dressing them in confident blanks. Qiu wanted one additional question: whether revisions made the sequence too long to be useful. Yue added it. Collaboration would not mean that speed vanished under the word care. It would mean speed had to reveal its own conditions.

rival_cooperate_joint_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_joint_006.text: They also agreed a stopping rule for the relationship itself. If a future disagreement could not be resolved within the scope, they could stop the affected question, preserve the actual work and separate without rewriting the other woman's contribution. Qiu called that a bleak beginning. Yue asked whether pretending it could never happen would be warmer. Qiu laughed and took the brush. 'Write a path out before we trap ourselves with good intentions.' The proposed partnership gained a boundary without losing its appeal.

rival_cooperate_joint_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_joint_007.text: The present fixture returned to facility storage, with the original wet guide and revised dry guide separately named. They did not keep it assembled as the first instrument of their future workshop. There was no workshop yet. The joint trial's result belonged to its own three afternoons and actual communication route. Qiu retained her proposed latch drawing; Yue retained the pin drawing; both retained the joint account. Their new future enquiry would carry those pages as experience, not as a certificate granting authority to supervise strangers.

rival_cooperate_joint_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_joint_008.text: At the kitchen door, the cook asked whether the argument had finished. Qiu said it had developed a second question. The cook groaned and handed them the remaining spring onions he could not use before closing. They accepted them as an ordinary offered gift, checked that he meant to give them away and divided the small bundle. Yue held her share in the satchel's outer pocket. Qiu said a partnership beginning with onions ought to resist becoming pompous. Yue suggested that the onions would provide their own corrective pressure.

rival_cooperate_joint_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_joint_009.text: They walked to the quay fork discussing a possible short title for the future draft. Qiu favored Clear closure; Yue said it claimed too much before work. Yue favored Instructions under observation; Qiu said it sounded like people would be imprisoned beneath a sheet of paper. They settled temporarily on another question and laughed at the surrender of both titles. Even a title could wait. The pleasure of planning together was real, and its reality did not require a finished study to be invented ahead of time.

rival_cooperate_joint_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_joint_010.text: Yue returned to the receiving loggia with an offered future collaboration accepted as an intention to develop a proposal, not as a completed or booked study. Its question, open items and exit boundary were written. Existing accepted dates remained in force. Qiu would meet her again only under a later actual agreement. The present joint trial stayed complete with its own bounded result. Yue had gained a qualified prospective partner and retained a rival's useful pressure, while her cultivation, shoulder and purse had acquired no fictional reward.

rival_cooperate_end_001.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_end_001.text: Yue chose to end their joint instrument work after this completed trial. Qiu's expression hardened for a moment. 'Because I still want it faster?' she asked. 'Because our next questions can be pursued separately,' Yue answered. 'I do not need another shared table to acknowledge what you helped show.' Qiu looked toward the gauge station's dripping roof. She had offered a future idea and could hear a refusal without turning the three afternoons into a deception. 'Then let us make the end as clear as the setup,' she said.

rival_cooperate_end_002.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_end_002.text: They listed what ending meant. No future joint session was accepted. No instruction study had begun. Each could keep her permitted copies and develop her separate contributions under the ordinary boundaries of authorship. The joint account would retain both names and the communication route actually chosen. A later necessary correction to that account could still be discussed; ending collaboration did not grant either woman the right to repeat a known false statement. The boundary closed prospective work while preserving responsibility for what they had already said.

rival_cooperate_end_003.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_end_003.text: Qiu asked whether Yue wanted to remove her name from the joint fixture. Yue said no. Ending a relationship did not erase shared authorship. Qiu nodded with visible relief. She had mistaken the refusal for a possible rejection of the whole trial. Yue could value the apparatus, the sharp questions and the bread conversation without choosing to continue. Su, when they returned, checked that the closure note described an ended collaboration rather than a failed trial. Their actual recorded instrument result had not changed.

rival_cooperate_end_004.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_end_004.text: Su accepted the closure note and returned the borrowed parts to their proper storage. The separate grant's unused balance remained under the facility's recorded return, beyond either purse. There was no severance payment or forfeited prize. Qiu inspected the guide trays one last time. Yue checked the permitted copies against the facility original. The practical work of ending was low, cold and undramatic. It let the two women leave without a box of unspoken obligations disguised as spare parts.

rival_cooperate_end_005.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_end_005.text: Qiu said she would pursue a shorter instruction sequence on her own. Yue wished her a question clear enough to reveal failure. Qiu almost took that as another rebuke, then smiled grudgingly. 'And I wish you an endpoint that doesn't keep moving because the world can always supply one more doubt.' Yue accepted it. These were the criticisms they would retain from each other. Ending collaboration did not have to make them gentle to the point of dishonesty. It did require them to speak without seeking another round of surrender.

rival_cooperate_end_006.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_end_006.text: On the quay, they saw the older man and his daughter waiting for a covered ferry. He raised a hand and asked whether the new catch would reach his shed someday. Qiu said she intended to keep working on the question but had no promised delivery.

rival_cooperate_end_007.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_end_007.text: Qiu offered to carry Yue's satchel as far as the receiving desk. Yue declined because it rested comfortably against her body and she wanted to make her own stop along the way. The refusal required no struggle for independence. Qiu accepted it and shifted her own rolled drawings under her arm. Their cooperation had included accommodating Yue's shoulder; its ending did not make every future courtesy suspect. A person could decline help because she did not need that help at that moment, without condemning the offer.

rival_cooperate_end_008.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_end_008.text: They parted at the kitchen door. The cook asked whether the table trial would return tomorrow and was pleased to hear no. He had other work that needed the loggia's quiet. Qiu laughed at the unceremonious relief. Yue thanked him for the soup, the onion bread and the space to stop being instrument authors for part of an afternoon. He said he remembered them chiefly as the two women who had refused to repair his wobbling table. That memory belonged to him, and neither tried to improve it.

rival_cooperate_end_009.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_end_009.text: Alone on the quay, Yue found that ending had not made the trial feel wasted. Qiu's objection to invisible patience would remain with her the next time a delayed answer consumed someone's useful day. Her own insistence on partial signs had entered Qiu's revised cards. Neither lesson required a continuing partnership to be true. She could leave with affection for parts of the encounter and irritation at others. A completed chapter of work did not need to close every question about the people who had shared it.

rival_cooperate_end_010.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_end_010.text: Yue reached the receiving loggia with a completed joint trial and an actual closure of future collaboration. No prospective instruction study was accepted, no continued rivalry pact was written and no unchosen communication route had occurred. Her permitted pages recorded the contributions, stops, revisions and bounded result supported by this path. Existing bookings remained binding, her shoulder retained its limits and her cultivation stayed at Four pairs. The receiving desk could now offer another ordinary choice from the calendar she actually had, rather than one invented to prolong the encounter.

rival_cooperate_future_scene_002_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_future_scene_002_b.text: The river carried pieces of reed past the measuring post. Qiu watched one catch in an eddy and free itself. 'I wanted you to see a fast method,' she said. 'I saw one with conditions,' Yue answered. 'That is more than I expected to be glad of,' Qiu said.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_014_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_014_b.text: They watched a boatman cover a load of empty baskets. Rain threatened the baskets differently from the rope, the deck and the man's patience. Qiu said their fixture had equally separate vulnerabilities. Yue answered that it would help to name them before the first drop made everything seem like weather.

rival_cooperate_third_006_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_006_b.text: At Su's first tap, the pin gap was free; at the second it remained visible. The tongue then crossed its short travel. The inspected charcoal strip showed a narrow single rub. Both spoken reports came before the operators compared signs. The audience could follow the sequence without inventing an unseen force.

rival_cooperate_stop_012_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_stop_012_b.text: Qiu pointed to the collar, then lowered her hand. She pointed to the lighting board, then shook her head. 'I can dislike the delay without believing the parts useless,' she said. Yue felt her own impatience answer. She had wanted Qiu to enjoy the delay; that was an unreasonable demand.

rival_cooperate_recover_divide_007_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_divide_007_b.text: Qiu said, 'If tomorrow you need to stop, say it before you prove you can endure.' Yue answered, 'If tomorrow the tongue rubs, say it before you prove you can close it.' They accepted the symmetry without making injury and rubbing the same event.

rival_cooperate_recover_stop_008_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_stop_008_b.text: Yue could value the diagnostic work without promising tomorrow would succeed. They gave Su the new page and left at the agreed finishing time. The wet guide remained on its tray; the dry rebuilt apparatus remained under the separately checked cover. Their last afternoon would answer only the question they actually performed.

rival_cooperate_third_004_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_004_b.text: Yue pointed to the current instruction cards. The first afternoon's actual route history stayed available on its own page. Anyone could ask which work had occurred; nobody was required to master the entire narrative before noticing a touching pan.

rival_cooperate_017_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_017_b.text: The dust fell into a saucer. They did not blow it toward the pans. When the burr vanished, Qiu tried the tongue with two fingers. It glided, then stopped at an uneven shoulder inside the notch. A short motion had still found room for a surprise.

rival_cooperate_divide_015_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_015_b.text: The two women cleaned the low table together, sliding the saucers rather than carrying them overhead. Qiu looked at the strand caught in the dust saucer. 'Tomorrow I want to know how this behaves when the courtyard isn't so obliging.' Yue glanced at the sky. 'It may volunteer an answer.'

rival_cooperate_swap_009_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_009_b.text: They chose the shorter strip and added a low wooden lift tab beyond the contact area. Su asked them to show that the tab did not touch the tongue. The audience watched the gap they had almost forgotten to make visible.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_008_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_008_b.text: 'Care can use someone else's hunger as a clock and still feel virtuous,' she said. Yue listened without claiming that her own patience was different by nature. She asked what the repair shop did when a quick return failed. Qiu rubbed the spoon's handle. 'Sometimes we paid the second journey. Sometimes we argued instead.'

rival_cooperate_kitchen_016_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_016_b.text: Qiu accepted the sentence with a grimace. They parted with tomorrow's time confirmed and no promise of agreement. Yue walked home carrying her own paper. The prospect of seeing Qiu again felt less like surviving an opponent and more like returning to an unfinished conversation.

rival_cooperate_rain_009_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_009_b.text: Qiu rotated the hook gently while the pan rested on the mat. The corrections made a different current assembly. They marked both changes before lifting the pan clear, so later closure could not erase the path by which it had become usable.

rival_cooperate_third_010_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_010_b.text: Qiu counted two completed qualifying observations and one stopped attempt. She did not say two out of two. Yue watched the visible pleasure and frustration cross her face together. The little fixture had worked within its terms, and it had also found another ordinary place to change.

rival_cooperate_end_006_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_end_006_b.text: Yue said their shared trial was complete. The daughter looked disappointed that there would be no combined workshop to visit. Her father thanked them for the afternoon anyway. An actual interested listener could accept a finished limited encounter, even when he would have preferred a larger future.

rival_cooperate_divide_012_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_012_b.text: Yue agreed. Their first series described the fixture with these operators, this loading order and dry parts. Nobody would be allowed to quote it as proof that the catch always worked. A small true answer seemed preferable to a splendid answer with a hidden owner.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_007_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_007_b.text: I expect a person to notice what speed makes difficult to see.' Qiu leaned forward. 'And I expect a slow person to notice what delay makes impossible to repeat.' Yue had no answer that disposed of that concern. She said, 'Then we should keep both questions alive.'

rival_cooperate_rain_002_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_002_b.text: The guide had been touched by the cover, and one pan assembly showed a changed hanging position. A new man asked who had left the cover loose. Su said she had accepted its storage arrangement. Qiu said both authors had failed to inspect the sag.

rival_cooperate_rain_008_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_008_b.text: The cord might also have changed length, but the slipped knot accounted for part of the lowered pan. They could retie it at the marked place and check the empty height. That would be an intervention in a known feature, not proof that damp cord had no other effect.

rival_cooperate_result_public_003_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_public_003_b.text: He did so from his seat and asked a useful question about the lift tab. They answered within their actual route instructions. A person's practical interest could survive a qualified result; they did not need to replace it with a grand promise to earn his attention.

rival_cooperate_019_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_019_b.text: 'No,' she said. 'It means our fingers can operate the empty apparatus.' Yue watched how she recovered from irritation. Qiu's hunger for a result remained fierce, but she could prevent another person from giving her one she had not earned.

rival_cooperate_025_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_025_b.text: Yue favored exchanging the methods so neither design depended on its inventor's touch. A third possibility was to stop the comparative claim today and use the session to find a fair fixture. The assembled beam waited while they faced that choice.

rival_cooperate_029_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_029_b.text: A challenge would pause the series so they could look. It would not count as evidence of a secret enemy or award the challenger a victory. 'We are not recruiting witnesses for a quarrel,' Yue said. Qiu met her eyes. 'We are recruiting a quarrel with our own first impressions.'

rival_cooperate_swap_010_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_010_b.text: Yue heard the firmness without possessiveness. 'A person who discovers a defect doesn't acquire the other person's whole idea,' she added. The repairer shrugged. 'I have seen workshops argue as if he does.' Both women knew that was a different trial, worth refusing here.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_009_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_009_b.text: They were not collecting absent people to defeat each other. She asked what would have let him leave honestly. 'A smaller claim,' Yue said. 'He could have said what he'd checked and what still needed checking.' Qiu nodded. 'I have asked for that from slow shops too.'

rival_cooperate_kitchen_012_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_012_b.text: She fixed it and smelled the sharp vinegar on her fingers. Qiu complained that the cook would now accuse them of improving his entire kitchen. The cook said they could begin with the table leg that had been wobbling for a year.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_015_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_015_b.text: Su could move the table to the loggia before the trial if the space was clear. None of that established weatherproofing. Qiu wanted a future method a stranger could repeat after ordinary rain. Yue wanted tomorrow's statement to remain smaller: how this fixture behaved after the conditions they actually observed.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_019_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_019_b.text: They used the stiff paper gap scrap from yesterday, keeping its dry edge dry. It entered the near side but stalled before the far side. Yesterday it had passed through. Su drew the current stopping depth on a fresh sheet with the rain still audible behind them.

rival_cooperate_rain_010_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_010_b.text: The blue coated man stayed, interested despite his complaint. Yue helped slide the inspection board toward the remaining observers without leaning across the beam.

rival_cooperate_public_003_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_public_003_b.text: She asked whether any part remained unclear. The blue coated man said he could follow the guide but not the pan change. Qiu laid the pan safely on the mat and showed the tail mark on the cord. One explanation had to be repeated.

rival_cooperate_public_010_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_public_010_b.text: It had not restored the lost comparison. Qiu and Yue left the loggia with a shared account of the failure visible behind them. Tomorrow's result would have to follow that account rather than pretending the second afternoon had been merely a pleasant interruption.

rival_cooperate_recover_divide_003_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_recover_divide_003_b.text: They kept a stop if rubbing appeared. The spare base was diagnostic; its parts had not inherited the exposed fixture's history. Qiu wrote that limitation under the new card before Yue could ask. They were becoming better at anticipating an accurate objection.

rival_cooperate_third_001_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_001_b.text: Qiu removed the cover along its marked low path and placed it in the storage basin. Yue could see no new wet contact. They checked the current tie marks, the pan cord tail, hook orientation and guide gap before describing the apparatus as ready for an empty rehearsal.

rival_cooperate_third_011_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_third_011_b.text: Su presented them on the pale board beyond the moving parts. He distinguished the narrow rub but called the creased edge a mark too. Qiu explained the location that counted. The exchange showed why the category examples belonged near the report, not only in the authors' memory.

rival_cooperate_result_withhold_004_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_result_withhold_004_b.text: Qiu could live with the blank more easily now that action had filled the surrounding page. Yue could acknowledge the repeated short motion without using caution to deny what it showed. They put the diagnostic copies away before deciding whether they wanted another shared table.

rival_cooperate_rivals_001_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rivals_001_b.text: 'And you will not describe my next quick catch as a lesson I still haven't learned.' Yue agreed. The trial had not given either woman permanent authority to narrate the other's future. They could retain an opponent without reducing her to a moral example.

rival_cooperate_rivals_007_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rivals_007_b.text: The beans were smoky, salt caught in their cracks. Qiu said a rival should be allowed to feed a person without weakening her future criticism. Yue answered that she intended to remember the beans precisely and the implied obligation not at all.

rival_cooperate_005_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_005_b.text: Qiu tapped the drawing with an uninked brush. 'I allowed that in the guide.' 'You allowed movement. You haven't shown how much.' Su supplied a scrap of stiff paper. A gap that could accept that scrap became more useful than the beautiful straight line.

rival_cooperate_016_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_016_b.text: Yue added that either operator could stop. The visitor looked disappointed that a public trial would not become a spectacle. Su handed him the chalk and invited him to improve the viewing line instead. He found a useful job for his enthusiasm.

rival_cooperate_018_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_018_b.text: Qiu considered the difference between hiding an inconvenient result and correcting an observed construction defect. She drew the shoulder on the side view, marked its removal and kept the shaving in the saucer beside the dust. The audience could see where the first version ended.

rival_cooperate_020_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_020_b.text: Qiu said, 'You may see both of us concede several things and still disagree.' The customer laughed. 'That sounds slow.' Qiu tipped her head toward Yue. 'She has been teaching the apparatus to share her talent.' Yue found herself smiling before she had decided to.

rival_cooperate_022_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_022_b.text: A fallen pan would strike the soft mat, not a foot. The small drop could be observed without drama. Qiu said the mat might conceal the sound of a slipping hook; Yue replied that they had eyes and a marked clearance.

rival_cooperate_030_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_030_b.text: Yue wanted a method whose apparent success did not conceal an unmentioned condition. Their aims crossed in more than one place. It was possible to quarrel over the route while sharing the destination, provided neither woman pretended the route did not matter.

rival_cooperate_divide_006_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_divide_006_b.text: Qiu then closed the tongue without reaching over the beam. The charcoal mark showed a narrow rub. Yue reported a free gap; Qiu reported a single contact mark. Only then did they inspect each other's witness. The porter who had questioned cultivation leaned forward to compare the two observations.

rival_cooperate_swap_007_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_swap_007_b.text: Qiu reported a gap beside the collared pin. Yue slid the tongue through its short travel. The charcoal strip showed one narrow rub. Each woman had produced the other's sign without a hand reaching across the apparatus. Qiu exhaled as if she had been holding more than breath.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_006_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_006_b.text: Yue took the bowl while Qiu used both hands low on the shutter bar. The exchange was easy because neither woman pretended she could do two things safely at once. Outside, the air smelled of river mud stirred beyond the reeds. Tomorrow's ordinary handling might not be as dry as the plan.

rival_cooperate_kitchen_017_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_kitchen_017_b.text: It had not poured onto the fixture, but the wet sag rested against the top guide. Qiu had not lifted it yet. 'I wanted a witness before I improved the scene,' she said. Yue put her satchel in the loggia and returned to look.

rival_cooperate_rain_005_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_005_b.text: Qiu found that partial result maddening. Yue knew the same feeling. A cause that solved half a problem tempted a person to call the other half insignificant. They kept the original gap sketch and the loosened-gap sketch on the same page rather than replacing one with the other.

rival_cooperate_rain_015_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_015_b.text: The outlines differed near the notch. They could not tell from those outlines whether swelling alone had caused the difference because the original fastening had moved too. The spare gave them a useful reference shape. It was not an unexposed twin whose history matched every cut.

rival_cooperate_rain_017_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_rain_017_b.text: She washed her hands at the low basin and dried them before touching the packet. Yue washed hers too. The audience watched a mundane precaution with no need for a speech about purity. Charcoal could travel by fingers; clean hands made the intended marks easier to interpret.

rival_cooperate_private_007_b.speaker: narrator
rival_cooperate_private_007_b.text: Yue showed her the route sheet they had actually made rather than reciting some other planned series. The woman's relief was mixed with disappointment. She had hoped to tell her father of a catch that would close easily in his damp shed. Qiu declined that promise.
